articleTitle: Multi-Spatiotemporal Dynamic Graph Convolutional Recurrent Network for Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the traffic flow prediction problem, most of the work uses a static adjacency matrix defined by prior knowledge to model the spatiotemporal correlation, ignoring the dynamic nature of traffic data. To accurately describe the dynamic relationships among nodes, a multi-spatiotemporal dynamic graph convolutional recurrent network is proposed for traffic flow prediction. First, the node embeddings are generated into new dynamic graph embeddings using a spatiotemporal embedding generator, and the node similarity is used to construct a dynamic graph, and the dynamic graph convolution module is used to fuse the dynamic spatial correlations at different times fully. Then, the current traffic signals and the dynamic graph embeddings are modeled with multi-temporal and spatiotemporal dependencies using the dynamic graph method. Finally, the obtained hidden representations are inputted into the prediction layer to obtain the final prediction results. Experiments are conducted on two real datasets, and the results show that the proposed model exhibits superior prediction performance compared to other baseline models.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Electromagnetic Wireless Transmission Channels in Oil Wells
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Downhole pressure and temperature monitoring of oil production wells is one of the effective means to ensure normal and efficient development of oil and gas wells. Aiming at the problems of the conventional ways such as downhole storage manometer, the method is proposed which transmit downhole information using wireless low-frequency electromagnetic wave. Firstly, an electromagnetic wave transmission channel model for oil wells was established based on the equivalent transmission line theory, considering factors such as tubing, casing, and annular media. Secondly, the channel model was simulated using COMSOL Multiphysics software to analyze the impact of frequency and casing contact on the transmission of electromagnetic signals in oil wells, providing a theoretical basis for the application of electromagnetic wave wireless transmission technology in oil and gas wells. The simulation results show that:(1) At the same transmission depth, as the frequency of the electromagnetic signal increases, the voltage received on the ground continuously decreases. (2) When the oil casing is in contact, the contact impedance on the coupling channel decreases due to the short-circuit effect, resulting in an increased signal amplitude received at the surface.

articleTitle: Design for an orientation algorithm of AHRS based on gain scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, the AHRS has become an important research area. In order to improve the orientation measurement accuracy of AHRS, this paper first expounds the algorithm principle of the AHRS. Then, aiming at the problem of poor stability of the traditional gradient descent method under high dynamics or large magnetic field interference, a gain-scheduled anti-interference AHRS orientation algorithm is designed. By using the switching architecture designed with this algorithm for gain scheduling, it can ensure stable performance while being subjected to apparent acceleration and ferromagnetic interference. Finally, experimental verification is conducted, and the experimental results show that: in the presence of interference, the roll angle error is 0.0350°, the pitch angle error is 0.0277°, and the yaw angle error is 0.9611°, thereby verifying the strong anti-interference performance of the gain-scheduled AHRS orientation algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Automatic Control Design and Stability Analysis of Ocean Cement Ash Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The cement supply system is affected by gas-solid two-phase flow. There are some problems in the ash supply process, such as large fluctuation of cement ash weight, unstable ash supply and inability to monitor the cement ash flow, which affect the density of cement slurry in the slurry mixing process. According to the above problems, the automatic ash supply experiment system based on Programmable Logic Controller(PLC) controller is designed to analyze the influence of tank pressure and valve opening on ash conveying rate and fluctuation of the law, use single loop PID control algorithm to control the amount of ash tank pressure and constant pressure tank, solve the fluctuation of weight signal in the high frequency vibration system, calculate the weight change of the constant pressure tank and cement ash receiving tank in each cycle, and indirectly measure and calculate the ash conveying rate of constant pressure tank. The experimental results show that the tank pressure and valve opening can effectively improve the stability of ash supply in a reasonable interval, The minimum average volatility is at the tank pressure of 30 psi and the valve opening of 75%, the results effectively improve the automatic control of the ash supply system in cementing operation, and can provide guidance for the ash supply experiment under different offshore conditions.

Author Keywords: Calculation of ash conveying flow rate

articleTitle: GNSS deformation monitoring analysis based on the spatio-temporal Kalman filter: A comparison study
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Kalman filter (KF) is a widely applied technique for deformation monitoring, which can estimate the deformation displacement from the noisy Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) measurements. This work compares the traditional KF and spatio-temporal Kalman filter (STKF) from the aspect of algorithm models and simulation results. The algorithm implementation of KF and STKF for deformation monitoring are given and analyzed in detail. In the case of stable deformation process, results show that both methods can accurately estimate the deformation displacement. In the case of sudden deformation process, such as burst step displacement and slope displacement, STKF outperforms KF via its spatio-temporal modelling. Based on the Kriging model, STKF can fully exploit the correlation among different monitoring points, then estimate the deformation without low delay.

articleTitle: Diesel Engine Cylinder Pressure Monitoring method based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The high-frequency sampled cylinder pressure data contains a lot of information about the working conditions of diesel engine generators. In this work, a cylinder dynamic pressure condition monitoring method based on compressed sensing is proposed. First, healthy dynamic cylinder pressure data is sampled using the established platform. Then, the compressed sensing method is applied using the Fourier matrix and Gaussian random matrix as the sparse matrix and measurement matrix, respectively. The compressed signal is reconstructed by the Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm and the maximum relative errors are calculated at different compression ratios. Based on engineering experience, the practical compression ratio is selected. Finally, the proposed method is validated by applying it to diesel engines with poor working conditions. The reconstructed signal is practical for diesel engine cylinder condition monitoring.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of High Sensitivity Multi Frequency Underwater Acoustic Transducers
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the field of marine exploration, responders are mostly used in shallow waters, with short transmission distances, low transducer sensitivity, and a single operating frequency, resulting in high costs and low efficiency in oil exploration work. Therefore, it is necessary to design an underwater acoustic transducer that combines high sensitivity, multiple frequency points, and strong shock resistance. This design uses piezoelectric ceramic tubes made of lead zirconate titanate, with resonance frequencies of 19.8KHz and 28.8KHz, sensitivity of -187.08dB, and sound source level of 190-194dB. The test results show that the designed underwater acoustic transducer has high emission sound source level and reception sensitivity, which improves the communication distance of the responder. In addition, this design can continue to increase the number of resonance points to achieve more responders responding simultaneously, and has scalability.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing Based on WOA-VMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of difficulty in extracting fault features of rolling bearings and the impact of external excitation on the accuracy of fault diagnosis, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on whale optimization algorithm and LSTM(Long Short Term Memory) improved variational mode decomposition combined with support vector machine optimized convolutional neural network. Firstly, the variational mode decomposition of the vibration signal of the rolling bearing is carried out, and the minimum envelope entropy is taken as the fitness function, and the whale optimization algorithm is used to determine the number of decomposition modes and the secondary penalty factor of variational mode decomposition. Secondly, the LSTM noise reduction network is constructed, and the modal components decomposed by the variational mode are introduced into the noise reduction network, and the vibration signal after noise reduction is obtained by reconstructing each mode after noise reduction. Finally, support vector machine is used as the classifier of the convolutional neural network, and the vibration signal after noise reduction is input into the convolutional neural network to realize fault diagnosis. The analysis of experimental results shows that the method proposed in this paper has high fault diagnosis accuracy and better robustness.

articleTitle: Inversion Research of Horizontal Well Array Induction Logging Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to improve the computational efficiency and accuracy of the nonlinear inversion of horizontal well array induction logging, the neural network is introduced into the inversion of induction logging data. Firstly, the database of horizontal well array induction logging samples is established. Then, BP, RBF and convolutional neural network prediction models are built respectively, and training and testing are carried out based on sample database. During training, log response is taken as the input of neural network, and formation parameters are taken as the output of neural network. The prediction results of different neural network models are compared and analyzed, and the prediction results are visualized by graphs. The results show that the relative error between the inversion results of the formation parameters and the true value of the formation model is lower than 5%, and the evaluation indexes and prediction accuracy of the convolutional neural network prediction model are better than those of the BP and RBF neural network prediction models.

articleTitle: An Compensation Method for Phase Time Delay of Laser Semi-Active Seeker
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: According to the fact that of phase delay in semi-active laser seeker, this paper presented a method for integrating laser detection and servo control, compensating for tracking delay. By using the rising edge of the reference signal to control the sampling time of each sensor,achieving group delay locking.Table loop composite correction ,tracking loop observation compensation ,and α-β filtering are used to reduce time delay and improve system stability and dynamic performance . The results of Simulaiton indicated that the stable loop bandwidth is greater than45°, the greater than 6dB, and the step response index of the tracking loop is better than that of the traditional tracking loop, the system delay is optimized and compensated, with good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Influence of coil structure on the distribution of transmitting magnetic field in downhole electromagnetic detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The electromagnetic method is widely utilized for downhole detection, significantly enhancing the safety and efficiency of oil and gas production due to its sensitivity to resistivity and its capability for non-destructive testing. However, due to the narrow space within the downhole, the azimuthal resolution of downhole detection is not ideal. Based on the finite element method, this paper achieved the forward simulation of magnetic field distribution in three-dimensional wellbore electromagnetic detection. Various structures of the transmitting coil in electromagnetic detection tools were studied and compared, and the impact of the structure of the transmitting coils on their circumferential magnetic field distribution was analyzed. The simulation and analysis results offer valuable insights for accurately and effectively designing the transmitting coils to improve their azimuth resolution.

articleTitle: Estimating dynamic nonlinear models of time-interleaved ADC in reproducing kernel Hilbert space
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes a model for Time-Interleaved ADC (TIADC) using the Volterra series to characterize the dynamic nonlinearities in the TIADC system. The proposed model serves as a general representation of TIADC mismatches. However, the use of Volterra series is limited to weakly nonlinear systems because the number of parameters increases exponentially. To reduce the complexity of measuring parameters of the proposed model, we recast the problem in reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) by using polynomial kernels. The effectiveness of the proposed method is assessed through simulations.

articleTitle: A Heatmap-Based Weighted Multi-stream Fusion Network in Skeleton Modality for Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Human Action Recognition (HAR) has received widespread attention in recent years. For skeleton modality, the representation of spatio-temporal motion and the weight allocation of different streams are still under discussion. Therefore, we propose a Heatmap-based Weighted Multi-Stream Fusion Network, HW-MSFN, which attempts to represent spatiotemporal motion in a novel way, prompting the adaptability of 3D-CNN to motion. Additionally, compared with the slow motion obtained frame by frame, we use fast motion which is captured at a larger time scale, in order to attain more general motion characteristics. Finally, to make full use of inter-frame information and intra-frame information, we explore the best weight allocation of multiple stream fusion for skeleton modality. Experiments implemented on 3 databases including HMDB51, UCF101 and FineGYM99 show that our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods in single skeleton modality.

articleTitle: Development of data acquisition module for intelligent balance
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Wind tunnel force measurement experiment is the most basic and major experimental project in wind tunnel experiments, and the wind tunnel strain balance is the most important and indispensable measurement device in wind tunnel force measurement experiments. In this paper, for the polynomial balance calibration formula fitting method based on the least squares method can not eliminate the error caused by the nonlinearity of the balance to develop a neural network equipped with intelligent balance data acquisition module, by comparing with the traditional least squares method, the neural network can effectively improve the accuracy of the acquisition, and provide a new technical means for the comprehensive correction of the static error. In this paper, an intelligent balance data acquisition module equipped with neural network is developed, which can eliminate the nonlinear error brought by the insufficient rigidity of the balance in the calibration process. The hardware design and software design of the collector are given in this paper. Finally, the data accuracy is analysed according to the technical specification requirements.

articleTitle: Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks for Weld Defect Detection: An Innovative SDR Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for detecting welding defects in oil and gas pipeline welds by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Suspected Defect Regions (SDRs) for non-destructive testing. X-ray images of welds are often compromised by high levels of noise and low contrast. To mitigate these issues, we apply mean filtering and sine function enhancement to process the images. We then introduce a gray density-based SDR segmentation technique and employ CNNs for defect identification within the segmented SDRs. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly enhances the automation of welding defect detection, achieving an accuracy of 98.9%.

articleTitle: Design of Bionic Robots for Underwater Surveys
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Underwater robots have already played an important role in the development of marine resources, marine environment monitoring, deep sea exploration and rescue, military applications, scientific research and human civilisation heritage protection and other fields. Underwater bionic robots make full use of the characteristics and behavioural principles of natural organisms, simulate the appearance, movement mode and perception mechanism of marine organisms, break through the weaknesses of traditional underwater robots, such as bulky structure of the mechanical frame, low efficiency of the movement, and greater interference from factors such as water currents and waves, and can better adapt to the complex marine environment, which has become the hotspot of research. Based on the principle of bionics, this paper puts forward a kind of underwater survey bionic robot around solving the difficulties of motion bionics and morphology bionics of underwater bionic robot, hydrodynamic problem of computational fluid dynamics, optimisation problem of underwater attitude control, and smoothness problem of motion in survey work. The underwater survey bionic robot designed in this paper can coexist harmoniously with the natural environment, can carry lightweight survey instruments to work underwater for a long time, and effectively carry out underwater resource data feedback, which has a very broad application prospect in the development of marine resources and seabed exploration.

articleTitle: Measurement of Vacuum Interrupter Shell Thickness Based on Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The vacuum interrupter serves as the core component of a vacuum circuit breaker, and the thickness of its shell is a crucial indicator for evaluating its quality. In order to achieve accurate measurement of the vacuum interrupter’s thickness, a BP neural network model is constructed. This model allows for obtaining the thickness measurement results directly through input and output relationship mapping, without the need to calculate the refractive index. This approach effectively avoids errors in refractive index caused by uneven microstructure of ceramics. Experimental results demonstrate that after BP neural network training, prediction accuracy is further improved. When compared with five other machine learning models, the BP neural network exhibits superior performance in thickness prediction, achieving an accuracy rate of 99.9975%. Therefore, this study proposes a method for measuring terahertz vacuum arc extinguishing outer shell thickness based on BP neural network technology. This method can effectively enhance measurement accuracy and precision, thereby holding significant importance for ensuring safe operation and maintenance of vacuum circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Algorithm for Cold Cathode Weld Defect Based on Improved Retinex Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the issues of low contrast and poor visual quality in cold cathode weld defect images, an image enhancement algorithm based on an improved Retinex theory is proposed. First, bilateral filtering is used to remove stripe noise in the image. Next, the guided filter in the improved Retinex algorithm is used to estimate the illumination component, thus obtaining the reflection component. The illumination component is processed using contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE), while the local details of the reflection component are enhanced using an improved Butterworth high-pass filter. The illumination and reflection components are then fused in a proportional manner. Finally, the image is enhanced using an improved homomorphic filter, resulting in the enhanced image. The algorithm's effectiveness is evaluated using subjective and objective assessment methods, with results indicating good image enhancement performance and more visible details.

articleTitle: Research on the System Design and Application of Mobile Manipulator Hybrid Robot for Transporting in Intelligent Factory
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Based on the development and application status of mobile manipulator hybrid robot, this paper takes the handling process requirements of intelligent factories in China as the research objective to design and develop a composite robot platform system. The hardware system mainly includes mobile platforms, manipulators, and sensors. The software system mainly consists of control systems, software architectures, algorithm libraries and corresponding communication protocols. This platform system has the key technologies of scene information perception, mobile path planning and self-collision detection of the manipulator during the grasping process, which are necessary in engineering project applications. The corresponding innovative algorithms are embedded in it, and scene tests and effect analysis are carried out in a memory module production factory. Test results show that, compared with mainstream products and application technologies in the field, this mobile manipulator hybrid robot can use multiple sensors to obtain scene information and conduct high-precision data fusion, simultaneously meet multiple measurement indicators of mobile path planning, and quickly achieve pre-collision warning without the application of sensors, verifying the effectiveness and advancement of the independently developed platform system.

articleTitle: Fast Total Focusing Method Based On Elliptical Arc Scanning algorithm and OpenCL Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Total focusing method (TFM), as the most effective post-processing technique for ultrasonic phased array imaging currently, can achieve focusing at any point within the detection area, possessing advantages of high resolution and signal-to-noise ratio that traditional phased array imaging methods lack. However, Total Focusing Method (TFM) imaging requires delay-and-sum processing of full matrix capture (FMC) data. If the number of elements involved in signal acquisition is N, the full matrix data will contain N A-scan signals, each containing thousands of sampling points.This will result in long computation time and make it difficult to achieve real-time imaging. This paper proposes a fast total focusing method that combines elliptical arc scanning algorithm and OpenCL hardware acceleration, and deploys it to a self-developed ultrasound phased array imaging system. Results show that the fast total focusing method can generate a 512 × 512 pixel image with 32 elements in an average time of only 64 milliseconds, far surpassing the time required by conventional total focusing algorithms, providing a feasible approach for real-time high-precision non-destructive testing online.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Universal Current Transformer Ratio Calibration Measurement without Power Cut
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the continuous development and complexity of the power system, the demand for accurate measurement and monitoring of power flow is increasing day by day. However, traditional verification methods based on current transformers have limitations in application, such as low detection efficiency, the need for power outages, and susceptibility to harmonic interference. In order to overcome the above difficulties, this article proposes a universal current transformer magnification verification method that combines wireless transmission, flexible coils, and harmonic analysis techniques. Then, ratio verification experiments were conducted on 35kV and 10kV current transformers to simulate harmonic interference of different orders by inputting harmonic components, and to test the harmonic analysis capability of the proposed method. In addition, the universality of the cable testing method is achieved by equipping cables with circular cross-sections and smaller cross-sectional areas. The experimental results show that the proposed method can accurately measure the transformation ratio error of current transformers without the need for power outage, verifying the superiority of this method in improving verification accuracy and universality.

articleTitle: The Regulation of Nitric Oxide Concentration in Air Plasma and Spectral Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As the applications of nitric oxide (NO) continue to expand, research on nitric oxide has increasingly garnered attention. Air plasma technology, characterized by its high efficiency and eco-friendliness, has become an important approach to studying NO generation. Air plasma is generated using a high-voltage alternating current power supply, followed by the collection of nitric oxide concentration data and spectral analysis. The research results indicate that higher voltage leads to increased emission spectra and NO concentration, with optimal results achieved at 9 kV. The optimal electrode spacing is 3 mm, which helps maintain the stability of arc discharge and increase NO generation. Excessive gas flow rates reduce NO generation efficiency, while moderate flow rates enhance the residence time of reactants, thereby increasing NO yield.

articleTitle: Enhancing Marine Species Detection: A Comparative Study of Backbone Networks in fastRCNN with Limited Dataset Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study aims to harness a camera system for collecting marine ecological data and potentially uncovering novel species. Although numerous research teams have successfully employed machine learning models to analyze visual data, these models frequently encounter challenges in adapting to the dynamic marine environment. In response to this issue, our research is centered on refining the application of the Fast RCNN machine learning model through the acquisition of extensive visual data from marine habitats. A comparative analysis of various backbone feature extraction networks, including VGG16-BN, ResNet50-FPN, and MobileNetV3-FPN, revealed that VGG16 exhibits the highest effectiveness in accurately identifying, quantifying, and classifying marine species.

articleTitle: Air quality monitoring system based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In daily life, air quality has a great impact on human health. Based on the current demand for indoor air quality, an indoor air quality monitoring system is designed. The system can monitor PM2.5, formaldehyde and temperature and humidity values in the air. This design uses STM32F103C8T6 minimum system as the main control chip, through the temperature and humidity sensor DHT11, formaldehyde sensor ZE08-CH2O and particulate matter sensor GP2Y1014AU for data monitoring, 0.96 inch OLED display display data in real time. Through TTL to RS485 module and RS485 to USB communication with the host computer, convenient for users to understand the indoor air quality in real time.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of HVAC chilled water system based on load forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system is a critical component of building energy consumption, accounting for a significant portion of total energy usage. Given the inherent nonlinearity, susceptibility to environmental variations, and stringent energy efficiency requirements of HVAC systems, traditional control strategies, often based on fixed rules or empirical knowledge, frequently fall short in their ability to dynamically adjust control parameters and achieve substantial energy savings. This paper introduces a novel Model Predictive Control (MPC) approach for chilled water systems, leveraging genetic algorithms to optimize control strategies. The proposed methodology is designed to enhance energy efficiency by implementing an energy-saving optimal control scheme, complemented by the formulation of rational objective functions and constraint conditions. Experimental validation conducted on a simulation platform demonstrates that the proposed control strategy not only significantly improves system energy efficiency but also exhibits robust performance and reliability under various operational conditions. The results show that the optimized MPC strategy achieves a 10%−15% reduction in total energy consumption, providing a valuable reference for building energy efficiency management.

articleTitle: A conjugate gradient method for solving unconstrained optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: For the conjugate gradient method to solve the unconstrained optimization problem, given a new interval method to obtain the direction parameters, and a new conjugate gradient algorithm is designed. The global convergence of the algorithm under the Armijo step search is also discussed. Making use of MATLAB to programming, and numerical examples’ results show that the new algorithm is more efficient than the FR,PR,HS conjugate gradient algorithm based on Armijo step search.

articleTitle: A FIR computing characteristic analysis method based on arithmetic mean filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Arithmetic mean filtering is a widely used digital filtering method. In engineering applications, the number of filtering operation points N should usually be selected according to the parameter characteristics and filtering requirements of the signal, but the selection method of the average filter parameter N is still not clear enough, and the amplitude-frequency response characteristics of the filter are still worthy of attention. Based on the FIR characteristic analysis of arithmetic average filtering, its analytical mathematical relationship is derived, and a universally applicable operation point selection method and key data characteristics of filter amplitude-frequency response is given.

articleTitle: Virtual sensor design for azimuthal gamma measurement systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In response to the validation needs of the directional gamma measurement system, which require going underground or using equipment containing radiation sources, and the difficulty of conducting quantitative and qualitative debugging and verification under laboratory conditions, a virtual sensor designed for the directional gamma measurement system is proposed based on real sensor selection and attitude inversion algorithms. A testing group is also designed to verify whether the output of the virtual sensor meets the requirements. Test results indicate that the virtual sensor exhibits output characteristics consistent with those of the real sensor, enabling quantitative and qualitative validation of the directional gamma measurement system. It can replace the real sensor to assist in system development under laboratory conditions, helping to shorten the R&D cycle and reduce costs.

articleTitle: Multi-target tracking technology of phased array radar based on data processing resource scheduling algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the process of radar multi-target radar tracking, a variety of multiple targets will lead to a large amount of data to be processed, which increases the complexity of data processing and the computational load. At the same time, the motion characteristics and importance of different targets are different, and it is necessary to allocate data processing resources reasonably to achieve priority tracking of key targets. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a technology that uses advanced data processing algorithms and resource scheduling strategies to achieve efficient tracking of multiple targets by phased array radar systems. The technology determines the priority of different targets according to the importance and mobility of the target, and then changes in real time according to the number of targets and the state of motion. The situation dynamically adjusts the allocation of data processing resources, so that the radar system can process the reflected signals of a large number of targets in real time. Experiments show that the algorithm can accurately estimate the dynamic parameters such as position, velocity and acceleration of the target, and improve the monitoring ability and target recognition accuracy of the radar system.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Recognition of Welding Defects in Spiral Submerged Arc Welding Images
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study explores the use of the YOLOv5-master model for defect detection in images of spiral submerged arc weld seams. Given the pivotal role of image preprocessing in optimizing deep learning model performance, this work highlights the impact of these preprocessing steps on enhancing model learning and training efficiency. Various preprocessing techniques—including standardization, normalization, cropping, rotation, scaling, and flipping—were applied to ensure data quality and consistency, leading to improved model generalization and detection accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that a well-structured preprocessing workflow significantly boosted the YOLOv5-master model’s performance in identifying welding seam defects.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control Method for SCO2 Brayton Cycle Reactors
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, with advancements in turbomachinery and compact heat exchanger technologies, gas-cooled fast reactors (GCFR) using supercritical carbon dioxide (SCO2) as the working fluid have become a research focus. Compared to traditional helium Brayton and steam Rankine cycles, the SCO2 Brayton cycle offers higher efficiency and greater potential for miniaturization. However, the high-pressure and high-temperature operation of SCO2 reactors significantly increases control complexity, and conventional PID controllers show limitations under wide-ranging load changes or operational condition switches.This study proposes a PID controller optimization method based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) to dynamically adjust PID parameters for improved control performance. Simulations of step load changes and loss-of-flow accidents were conducted in a 15 MWth SCO2 gas-cooled microreactor. Results demonstrate that the method can quickly respond to load changes, maintain core power stability, and effectively limit core temperature rise during loss-of-flow accidents, ensuring key parameters remain within safety limits. The DDPG-PID controller outperforms conventional PID controllers in dynamic performance and safety, providing a reliable control solution for SCO2 reactors.

articleTitle: Receiver Design for Non-orthogonal Superimposed Pilot and Data in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This letter presents the application of the non-orthogonal superimposed pilot and data scheme to multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. This scheme eliminates the need for separate pilot transmission, thereby increasing transmission capacity. In contrast to traditional methods, at the receiver, we design SeResNet aiming to directly recover the transmitted bit data using neural networks from received signal, without the need for complex steps such as channel estimation and equalization. The application of the channel attention mechanism in SeResNet improves the ability to recover data at each layer in MIMO systems Extensive simulations are conducted to validate the effectiveness of this scheme, which demonstrates an approximate increase in transmission capacity of 9.52%. Moreover, the developed network showcases outstanding performance in symbol detection.

articleTitle: Experimental researches on temperature measurement of inclinometer based on mixed level uniform design
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To minimize the impact of temperature variations on inclinometers, temperature modeling methods are typically used to compensate for its output. However, using orthogonal or full factorial design experiments involves a large number of trials and can be time-consuming. This paper analyzes the environmental characteristics affecting inclinometer measurements and identifies temperature as the main factor limiting the accuracy. Based on the fundamental principles and characteristics of the uniform design method, a mixed-level uniform design is applied to the inclinometer’s temperature modeling experiment. A uniform design table was constructed for the required temperature modeling experiments, and the optimal experimental plan was determined accordingly. The results indicate that, compared to full factorial design experiments, using the mixed-level uniform design for inclinometer temperature compensation reduces the experiment time to 1/9 of the original. Furthermore, it effectively reduces the number of trials compared to orthogonal design, thus lowering costs.

articleTitle: Design and test of sensor for plume heat flow measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this paper, a differential heat flow sensor was designed and developed for the measurement of the engine plume heat flow based on temperature gradient and the principle of the relationship between temperature difference and heat flow. Through the analysis of the factors affecting the sensor response time, it is determined that the main factors affecting the sensor response time are measuring the diameter and thickness of the cavity, which provides a basis for the preparation of the sensor. Through the preparation and testing of the sensors, the test results showed that the response times of the two heat flow meters were 50 ms and 90 ms respectively, which could meet the requirements of the engine ground test plume heat flow measurements.

articleTitle: Frequency-phase composite modulation-based waveform design for detecting and jamming integrated signal
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the field of multifunctional radar waveform design, this paper proposes an integrated waveform design method for detecting and jamming, which is by the composite modulation of intra-pulse FM signals (non-linear frequency modulation (NLFM) and polyphase coded FM (PCFM) signals) and inter-pulse phase modulation signals. In this paper, two different modulation schemes are described in detail and a mathematical model of the integrated signals is developed. In addition, an objective function for evaluating the comprehensive performance of the detecting and jamming integrated signal is proposed in this paper. Simulation experiments verify that the proposed integrated signal can effectively suppress jamming on the non-cooperative radar while maintaining excellent detection performance, and exhibiting noise-like characteristics in the frequency band, thus reducing the probability of being intercepted by the non-cooperative radar. Based on the evaluation of the proposed objective function, the integrated signal in this paper surpasses some of the integrated signals proposed by domestic scholars in terms of comprehensive performance. It provides new theoretical and technological support for the design of integrated signals of multifunctional radar.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Well Logging Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Logging design is a prerequisite for the smooth progress of logging operations, and selecting appropriate, advanced, cost-effective, and safe well logging projects and instruments is crucial for swiftly addressing geological and engineering challenges in target wells. Collect historical logging data from 150 wells in China Seas to serve as training sample data. Extract various engineering attributes including lithology, formation temperature and pressure, well type, and reservoir porosity and permeability. Develop real-time decision models for well logging series and projects, leveraging machine learning techniques including decision trees, random forests, and vector inference machines. Collect sample data on the appliwireline conditions, operation records, and service prices of 116 types of wireline logging instruments and 38 types of logging-while-drilling instruments from COSL, Schlumberger, Baker Hughes, and Halliburton companies that have been serving in the Chinese Sea for a long time. Establish an optimization model that matches well logging instruments with geological characteristics using filtering algorithm. Simultaneously utilizing the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) algorithm for job risk analysis using tension simulation. The algorithm has been applied in 24 wells in 4 oil fields in China Seas, including high-temperature and high-pressure wells, high inclination wells, pre-exploration wells. The effective application effect has enhanced the timeliness and scientificity of pre-logging design, providing a novel approach for intelligent logging operations.

articleTitle: Design of a Smart Camera Vulnerability Detection System Based on Homology Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In recent years, the number of smart cameras has grown exponentially, and the number of attacks targeting them has also increased. Many of these devices lack adequate security mechanisms and connect to networks with vulnerabilities, creating significant pressure on the overall network environment. Traditional vulnerability scanning tools typically rely on simple feature matching methods for vulnerability detection, and they often perform redundant scans on devices with similar characteristics. This not only results in low efficiency but also leads to a higher false positive rate. This paper proposes a smart camera vulnerability scanning system based on device homogeneity analysis. By quickly identifying security vulnerabilities in devices with the same architecture and components through homogeneity analysis, and leveraging machine learning algorithms to enhance the accuracy of vulnerability detection, the system significantly improves scanning efficiency and reduces false positives.

articleTitle: SVGACrack: Sparse Vision Graph Attention Segmentation Networks Enabling Precise Pavement Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Most current pavement crack detection tasks depend on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformer Networks (ViT) for feature extraction, and this dependency often makes it difficult to effectively capture irregular and complex cracks, which in turn affects crack detection performance. To tackle this challenge, this paper proposes a novel graph-based sparse attention mechanism encoder-decoder structure model for pavement crack detection (SVGACrack), which utilizes a hybrid CNN-GNN architecture MobileViG as the encoder backbone for multi-scale feature extraction in multiple stages, and the decoder adopts a lightweight multilayer perceptron structure, which uses an MLP layer first to unify the number of channels of the feature maps generated in each stage. The feature maps are then up-sampled and merged to capture both semantic abstraction and local details, improving detection accuracy. Finally, on the DeepCrack and Crack500 dataset, our proposed SVGACrack model obtains the highest F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-score, which outperforms current the state-of-the-art methods and proves its effectiveness in pavement crack detection.

articleTitle: Research and application of welding residual stress test of steel bifurcation based on magnetic method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The principle of magnetic measurement of residual stress and the application of magnetic anisotropy (MA) sensor are analyzed. The principal mechanical stress difference (DPMS) can be used to evaluate the elimination or homogenization of residual stress before and after hydraulic test. The feasibility, high efficiency and reliability of the magnetic measurement method are verified by measuring the residual stress of the 2# steel bifurcation before and after the hydraulic test in Jinyun pumped storage power Station.

articleTitle: The Future of Oximetry Monitoring: Integration of PPG Technology and Hardware Design in Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Photo Photo Plethyamo Graphy (PPG) technology is a non-invasive optical method for measuring changes in blood flow. The basic principle is based on the absorption and reflection of light: a specific wavelength of red or infrared light is emitted at the surface of the skin and, using the automatic absorption and reflection properties of the body's tissues, the optical signals generated by the attenuation of the reflectivity of the light intensity are passed through a sensor to generate an electrical signal. Due to the variability of haemoglobin types in the blood, different haemoglobins have specific absorption properties for different wavelengths of light. Therefore, PPG technology can assess blood flow status and blood oxygen levels by analysing light reflectance. In recent years, with the changes in science and technology and the increasing health consciousness of all people, the market demand for wearable oximetry wristbands has increased significantly. Various brands and models with different functions and price positioning have appeared in the market. In this thesis, research based on PPG technology is conducted and the optimisation of the hardware design of wearable oximeters is discussed. It is found in this thesis that the working performance of portable oximeters can be greatly improved after a series of hardware optimisation designs.

articleTitle: Distributed Coherent Aperture Radar Baseline Measurement Based on Cooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to enable the distributed coherent aperture radar (DCAR) to enter the cooperative mode of interferometry, it is necessary to calibrate each unit in the space, time and frequency domains, etc. The existing spatial baseline calibration method still has shortcomings in convenience, accuracy and flexibility. Aiming at the problem that the spatial baseline calibration mode of distributed coherent radar using signal phase-frequency information is not accurate enough to satisfy the system entering the fully coherent working mode, based on the cooperative unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) as the external radiation source, the hovering position of the UAV is independently planned to solve the problem of low accuracy and poor stability of baseline calibration by processing signals from multi-view observation. The simulation and data processing show that this method can further reduce the error of baseline solution and realize the coherent mode of distributed radar in airspace.

articleTitle: A local t-diagnosis algorithm for corruption detection on networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In an era where networks are crucial to the functioning of critical infrastructure, the ability to quickly and accurately identify compromised nodes using only local information is essential. This research aims to integrate insights from the SPMC model and corruption detection frameworks, proposing a novel algorithm that allows nodes to autonomously assess their status based on localized interactions. The SPMC model, an extension of the PMC model, is derived by introducing two key assumptions: (1) each adjacent node pair is assumed to be mutually tested; and (2) in one-step diagnosis, only the minimal consistent fault set corresponding to a given syndrome is identified. In this paper, we propose a diagnosis algorithm based on local diagnosis techniques to efficiently evaluate the state of a vertex in the system. The algorithm is proven to be correct and is not reliant on any structural assumptions or conjectures, making it applicable to any network. Furthermore, we demonstrate the application of our results to the hypercube Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of fracture on acoustic wave attenuation while drilling
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The development of fracture directly affects the storage performance of the reservoir. In order to better evaluate the fracture information, this paper numerically simulates the fractured formation under drilling conditions using COMSOL Multiphysics finite element software, and investigates the influence laws of different fracture widths and fracture zone densities on the attenuation of transverse and stoneley waves. The results show that in the presence of a horizontal fracture next to the well, direct stoneley waves and reflected stoneley waves are observed in the full wave train; The increase of fracture width and fracture zone density will cause the energy attenuation of transverse and stoneley waves; The attenuation coefficients increase with the increase of fracture width in a power function law, and with the increase of fracture zone density in an exponential function law; Stoneley waves are more sensitive to the fracture zone density than transverse waves.

articleTitle: B-spline Model for Extended Object Tracking Based on Sequential Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The B-spline model for extended object tracking (EOT) based on sequential fusion is proposed to improve EOT accuracy and reduce the effect of initial value. It uses B-spline model to construct target extension, and estimates the kinematic state and contour using sequential fusion. The measurement update using sequential fusion takes the previous measurement update as the initial value. Therefore, the B-spline model for EOT based on sequential fusion is characterized by high accuracy and tolerance to initial value error. Finally, a typical extended object tracking scenario is simulated, and the experimental results show that the tracking performance of the new method is outperform than the current method.

articleTitle: Fault detection of highway flow monitoring sensors based on grey correlation degree and neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Highway traffic monitoring sensors require real-time collection of a large amount of data, including traffic flow, vehicle speed, lane occupancy rate, etc. These data are not only large in volume, but also highly complex and dynamic, and are affected by various factors such as weather, road conditions, and vehicle types, which increase the difficulty of fault detection. This paper proposes a research method for fault detection of highway flow monitoring sensors based on grey relational analysis and neural networks. By using grey relational analysis to evaluate the correlation between highway traffic data and its influencing factors, the close relationship between key influencing factors and traffic has been determined. Furthermore, the BP neural network model is introduced to model and predict the output data of the flow monitoring sensor, and identify whether the sensor has malfunctioned. The experimental results show that the detection method combining grey correlation degree and neural network can effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of fault detection, providing strong guarantee for the stable operation of highway flow monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on multi-stage optimization control of office building air conditioning system based on DRL
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Global building energy consumption continues to increase, especially in heating ventilation air conditioning system (HVAC), so optimizing HVAC energy consumption becomes particularly important. As a key thermal system that can recover waste heat and improve energy efficiency , HP systems are widely used in HVAC. However, most of the current research focuses on local optimization of equipment inside the computer room, and in terms of optimization methods, deep reinforcement learning can effectively solve the problem that deep reinforcement learning is difficult to converge quickly. Therefore, considering the end environment, this study proposes a multi-stage model-free control method (MLC) to improve the cooling time of HP rooms in cold areas by combining DRL with traditional optimization algorithms and expert experience. Expert knowledge speeds up the agents' convergence, and the DRL optimizes the combined air conditioner's fresh air ratio (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">fa</inf>) and heat pump outlet temperature (T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">hps</inf>). According to testing data, the suggested approach saves 11.6% of energy during the cooling phase as compared to HVAC under the 2022 RBC plan. This approach ensures energy savings and may be used in any type of building without relying on real data.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Complex Target Signal Extraction Method Using Wiener and EMD Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the complexity and variability of the underwater environment, the target signal is often covered by complex environmental noise. In this paper, a combined algorithm based on Wiener wavelet threshold method and empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method is proposed to realize signal feature extraction in complex chaotic underwater acoustic environment. Firstly, Wiener filtering is performed on the original signal to remove a large amount of random noise; then the preprocessed signal is decomposed by EMD, the correlation between all modal components and the original signal is compared, the noise component is subjected to wavelet transform and noise reduction, and finally all modal components are reconstructed. Simulation results show that compared with other methods, the combined algorithm proposed in this paper has higher output signal-to-noise ratio and the smallest root mean square error. This research has a very important guiding role for the application of hydroacoustic engineering.

articleTitle: Large Model and Lip Feature Extraction: Key Fusion Points for Building an Efficient Lip Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article delves into the application of the large model in lip reading recognition, focusing on the basic principles and architecture of large models, and elaborating on their crucial role in lip feature extraction. The article begins by reviewing the development history of deep learning models, highlighting the characteristics and advantages of large models, and providing an in-depth analysis of typical large model architectures. Subsequently, addressing the difficulties and challenges in lip feature extraction, the article discusses the advantages of large models in feature extraction and explores how they can enhance the accuracy of lip reading recognition. Furthermore, the article compares traditional lip feature extraction methods with those based on deep learning, further highlighting the application value of large models. Building on this, the article proposes a fusion strategy of large models and lip feature extraction, and validates its application effects through experiments. The experimental results show that this fusion strategy can effectively improve the performance of lip reading recognition. Finally, the article summarizes the research findings and looks forward to the future development trends of lip reading recognition technology.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation Scheme of Channel Estimation Method for Leakage Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In an OFDM system utilizing virtual subcarriers, the LS-DFT method for channel estimation can introduce leakage effects during the time-frequency transform processing of the signal. To address this issue, this paper proposes an FPGA implementation scheme for a leakage-suppressed LS-DFT channel estimation method based on the optimal linear estimator with leakage suppression. MATLAB simulations are conducted on the OFDM system link using this proposed channel estimation technique. The results demonstrate that, under the conditions of a Rayleigh multipath channel and 16-QAM modulation, the leakage suppression method significantly enhances the signal-to-noise ratio compared to the conventional method, achieving a 0.8 dB improvement at a bit error rate of 10−4. Additionally, an indoor wireless communication transmission platform is constructed using FPGA boards, RF transceivers, and antennas to validate the implementation scheme, successfully achieving error-free transmission in the link. A comparison of hardware testing results with MATLAB simulations reveals a relative error of approximately 5%. In practical OFDM systems, the channel estimation FPGA implementation scheme presented in this paper effectively improves the system's demodulation threshold and holds substantial practical value.

articleTitle: Robust Predictive Position Control of Drug Delivery Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A new robust predictive control strategy is proposed for the position control of the drug delivery mechanism. Firstly, based on the dynamic model of the drug delivery mechanism, a generalized predictive position controller is designed. Then, on the basis of the designed generalized predictive position controller, the sliding mode compensation structure is added, which not only ensures the fast dynamic response of the original generalized predictive controller, but also suppresses the influence of the disturbance on the system. The simulation model of the control system of the drug delivery mechanism is built and the simulation analysis is carried out in the case of no drug and drug respectively. The results show that compared with PID control, the proposed control strategy has higher position control accuracy and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: A frequency domain property driven search method for echo state network structures
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To overcome the limitations of conventional echo state networks (ESN), such as redundant connections and insufficient frequency-domain feature extraction, this paper proposes a frequency-domain feature architecture search-based ESN (FS-ESN). Leveraging a frequency response fitness function, FS-ESN dynamically optimizes reservoir structures and incorporates frequency-domain features aligned with target tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that FS-ESN significantly improves feature extraction, adaptability, and predictive performance, outperforming traditional ESN models in task-specific applications.

articleTitle: A method of detecting the cross-section of ring components based on line structured light
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A method based on line structured light is proposed to measure the cross-sectional profile of large shaped ring components after traditional machining. Design the line structured light scanning process based on the structural characteristics of the ring section, so that the line structured light scanner with small range and high accuracy can be effectively applied to scan the profile of large ring sections. Perform SOR denoising, FPFH registration, and ICP registration on the scanned point cloud to obtain complete contour point cloud data of the ring section. A single contour point cloud feature point recognition method is proposed, which uses the least squares method to recognize circular arc segments and the slope threshold method to recognize straight line segments, reducing the difficulty of point cloud feature recognition. The experimental results demonstrate that this method controls the accuracy of contour measurement within ± 0.8mm, and the measurement accuracy, stability, and precision exceed traditional measurement methods.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Fixed-time Group Consensus for Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems with Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: For multi-agent systems (MAS) with external bounded disturbances and non-linearity, an event-triggered strategy for group consensus problem with fixed time is studied, and the factors of influence that agent state information triggers the controller update is given. This strategy can quickly reach group consensus in a fixed-time according to its individual state information and incomplete information of MAS. The time for MAS reaches convergence without constraints of its individual initial state, which can further reduce the communication cost and prolongs the life of MAS. Besides this strategy can reach group consensus without satisfying in-degree balance constraint. Combined with Lyapunov stability theory and algebraic diagrams, it is demonstrated that MAS affected by nonlinear terms and external bounded disturbances can reach group consistency in fixed-time and strictly exclude Zeno behavior. Finally, a simulation example verifies the feasibility of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors based on ultrasonic drilling mud density detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To optimize the accuracy of ultrasonic drilling mud density testing, we investigated the effects of emission frequency, particle size, and temperature on the test results. Through COMSOL Multiphysics simulation, we analysed the role of these factors on the ultrasonic attenuation rate and discussed the changing law of multi-parameter combinations. The simulation results reveal the relationship between the attenuation rate and spectrum, particle size and temperature, and the experimental data verify the effect of temperature. This study lays a theoretical foundation for improving the accuracy of ultrasonic density measurement.

articleTitle: Expansion of ship-radiated noise sample library based on marine three-dimensional sound field
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Ship radiated noise samples are crucial for accurate classification and identification of underwater passive sonar targets. A method that utilizes three-dimensional ocean acoustic field calculations is proposed to expand the ship radiated noise sample library. Based on the characteristics of ship radiated noise, simulations of ship radiated noise under different operating conditions were achieved through continuous spectrum and line spectrum components. By establishing a gridded underwater acoustic environment for the ocean and setting parameters for sound source and receiver positions, and using simulated ship radiated noise at sea as the sound source, the expansion of the array element domain received signal, namely ship radiated noise, was achieved based on three-dimensional ocean acoustic field computations. The comparison of power spectrum analysis of expanded samples under different ocean backgrounds and situations shows that although the impact of ocean sound propagation on ship radiated noise is extremely complex, the expanded samples can reflect the main characteristics of the original samples and can be used as samples for ship radiated noise classification and recognition.

articleTitle: Design Method for Complex Transmit Waveforms in Radio Fuze Based on Environmental Cognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The battlefield environment is becoming increasingly complex, and traditional radio fuzes with single transmit waveforms are no longer effective in coping with the complex electromagnetic environment and jamming from fuze interferers. To address this issue, this paper proposes a design method for complex transmit waveforms. The algorithm is capable of cognitive processing of detection results, enabling the fuze to adaptively reconfigure its transmit waveform in the presence of jamming and environmental effects, thereby avoiding the impact of jamming and complex electromagnetic environments. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm possesses strong anti-jamming capabilities and can operate stably in complex electromagnetic environments.

articleTitle: Friction signal denoising based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Addressing the issue of noise present in friction signals collected by scanning probe microscopy instruments, a denoising method for friction signals based on deep learning is proposed. This article proposes a denoising model that combines convolutional autoencoder, deep residual network, and attention mechanism. By using convolutional blocks and attention mechanism, different weights can be assigned to signal features. The residual network can effectively prevent gradient explosion and network degradation caused by increasing network depth. Generate simulated friction signals through numerical calculations and add Gaussian white noise to construct a training set for training and testing the model. This method successfully increased the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) of the signal by about 26dB, demonstrating excellent noise reduction performance.

articleTitle: Weld defect segmentation algorithm based on improved U-net
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The traditional convolutional neural network has the problems of insufficient accuracy and insufficient use of context features in weld segmentation. Therefore, an improved U-Net based weld segmentation algorithm is proposed, which uses VGG network as the coding part to enhance the feature extraction capability. At the same time, CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) and SENet (Squeeze and Excitation Networks) are introduced to enable the model to dynamically adjust the feature representation to highlight important channels and spatial locations. Thus improve the accuracy of classification and segmentation. The experimental results show that the accuracy and robustness of the improved model are significantly improved under complex background.

articleTitle: Research on Kinematic Simulation of Digital Pumping Unit Based on Matlab/ Multibody
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Intelligent pumping units are an important component of intelligent oil fields, and digital twin technology is an excellent solution for achieving intelligent pumping units. After building the digital geometric model of the pumping unit on the base of SolidWorks software, based on the Matlab/Multibody software platform, the component model and assembly constraint relationship based on XML are imported to realize the construction and connection of the multibody model. The model driver program are set and calculation results are obtained to complete the kinematic simulation analysis; Meanwhile, compared with the kinematic analysis results of the pumping unit based on vector method, the correctness and feasibility of the multibody model of the pumping unit based on Matlab/Multibody were verified. The analysis results of this article lay an important foundation for data perception, data fusion, and prototype software system development of digital pumping units based on digital twin technology.

articleTitle: Multi-cabin System for ILI of Oil and Gas Pipelines Based on Eddy Current Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the increasing concern about the safety of oil transportation, the ILI technology is becoming more and more important. By utilizing the pulsed eddy current with strong excitation and penetration ability, the ILI tool can conduct detections on different types of damages to pipelines. As the extremely slow response of the eddy current leads to the problem of low resolution in pipeline damage detection, a multi-cabin model is proposed to make up for the sparse measurement points of the traditional eddy current method. We have designed a multi-cabin ILI system and simulated the proposed model through COMSOL software. The results show that this method can not only more accurately determine the location of the defect, improve the longitudinal resolution of the instrument, but also depict the defect shape. This method and system are the applications in the construction of the transient electromagnetic technology practice platform, which enhances the ability of students to solve complex engineering problems.

articleTitle: Design and testing method of push-the-bit rotary steerable system bulid-up-rate evaluation device
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: For static push-the-bit rotary steerable drilling tool assemblies, existing build-up-rate(BUR) prediction methods are mostly theoretical calculations. Due to simplified modeling conditions, there are often errors in BUR prediction. To this end, based on the working principle of push-the-bit drilling tools, a set of static push-the-bit steerable drilling tool combination BUR evaluation device and evaluation method were established. The inclination ability of different drilling tool combinations was compared using the measured lateral force and deflection angle at the drill bit, and their inclination angles were simply calculated. The test results show that this method can easily and intuitively measure the tilting ability of rotary steerable drilling tools, meeting the evaluation of tilting ability for different drilling tool combinations; The deflection displacement at the steerable ribs and the lateral force at the drill bit have a significant impact on the tilting ability of the static push-the-bit rotary steerable drilling tool. Increasing the lateral force at the drill bit and increasing the eccentric displacement at the steerable ribs can effectively improve the tilting ability of the rotary steerable dirlling tool. The research results provide a theoretical basis for the optimization of rotary steerable drilling tool combinations and the evaluation of inclination ability.

articleTitle: A Rail Wear Measurement System Based on Line Structured Light and Binocular Camera Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-speed and heavy-duty railways, ensuring track health is crucial for the safety and efficiency of trains. Traditional methods for measuring rail wear, such as manual measurement and simple mechanical devices, are difficult to meet the high precision and efficiency requirements of modern railways. This article proposes a new type of rail wear measurement system, which is based on line laser and binocular cameras. The binocular camera system is used for multi viewpoint synchronous measurement, effectively overcoming the problem of incomplete information collection from a single viewpoint in complex environments. The experimental results show that the system has small fluctuations in repeated measurements, with a measurement accuracy of 0.02 millimeters and a standard deviation between 0.01 and 0.03 millimeters, significantly improving the stability and reliability of the measurement.

articleTitle: Research on control system of new energy storage combined thermal power unit based on improved voltage droop control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The new energy station and its configured energy storage of a certain scale can be used as a stable power supply point to participate in the whole process of black start of the thermal motor unit on the opposite side of the power grid. In this paper, active frequency and reactive voltage droop control strategies are adopted in the whole process of new energy storage black start. In order to keep the voltage stable in the initial stage of black start, that is, in the process of energy storage zero start boost air charging line, a voltage control scheme of variable slope energy storage inverter is proposed in this paper. The variable slope transfer function module is introduced into the traditional reactive power voltage droop control to suppress the impulse current in the process of black start voltage building. The above strategy is verified by Matlab / Simulink simulation. The scheme proposed in this paper can meet the requirements of the whole process of new energy storage black start and ensure the stability of the control system of energy storage inverter device.

articleTitle: Advanced Fault Prediction Techniques Utilizing LSTMSA-Based Method in More Electric Aircraft Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to overcome environmental concerns and reduce aircraft operating cost, the concept of More Electric Aircraft (MEA) has been presented to in-crease aircraft efficiency and reduce maintenance requirement by increasing the use of electrical power. Given the pivotal role of electrical systems in ensuring aircraft safety and stability, fault prediction within these systems is paramount for mitigating malfunction risks and ensuring the secure operation of MEA. This paper explores fault prediction techniques for MEA power systems, proposing a novel Long Short-Term Memory and Self-Attention (LSTMSA)-based method that significantly outperforms conventional prediction techniques. The proposed method enhances the fault prediction capabilities of MEA power systems, providing more meaningful references during flight and bolstering overall flight safety.
