articleTitle: Secure Data Exchange and Information Hiding through Color QR Code Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: QR code is known for rapid and high-capacity information transmission. Being easy to generate and widely used, it’s ideal for hiding information. This paper proposes a color QR code-based information hiding scheme to boost payload and security. It divides secret information into text and image, encodes text as QR code, and processes the image as a binary one. It utilizes QR code's error correction and human visual system's feature extraction ability for robustness. It does mask operation to embed extra image data. It employs different keys with logistic chaos systems for encryption and decryption. It designs a color mapping rule to embed all information types in one QR code, increasing storage capacity. Experiments show it quadruples payload while enhancing security and robustness.

articleTitle: Improvement of Euler Angle Algorithm Based on Extended Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Euler angles are essential parameters to describe the attitude of a carrier, and the Euler angles computed by the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) are affected by the performance of the components. Traditional Kalman filtering algorithms struggle to effectively suppress nonlinear Gaussian noise in engineering applications. Therefore, this paper employs an improved Extended Kalman Filtering algorithm(EKF), which linearizes the nonlinear system using the Jacobian matrix. It utilizes quaternions and gyroscope errors as state variables, while accelerometers serve as measurement inputs to update the quaternions, thereby obtaining the Euler angles. Building on the updated Euler angles, a magnetometer is incorporated to further refine the calculation, mitigating the impact of gyroscope z-axis drift on the heading angle and eliminating external magnetic interference. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared to the Madgwick algorithm and complementary filtering, the improved algorithm significantly reduces the influence of component errors on Euler angle calculations, minimizes bias drift, and better reflects the actual operational conditions of the carrier, effectively achieving filtering results.

articleTitle: Optimization of Acceleration Sensor Layout for Transmission Towers Based on the Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the structural response and condition monitoring of power transmission towers under landslide conditions. Focusing on a 110kV transmission tower in the rainfall-prone regions of southern China, we utilized ANSYS finite element analysis software to simulate the tower’s structural behavior and the impact of landslide-induced foundation displacement. A three-dimensional model of a double-circuit corner tower was developed, and optimization algorithms, including the Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), were applied to determine the optimal sensor layout. Results indicate that the DBO algorithm outperforms the PSO algorithm when using 4 to 6 sensors. With 8 sensors, both algorithms achieve stable and efficient monitoring performance. This study provides a reference for landslide disaster prevention and safety assessment of power transmission towers, recommending an optimized layout with 8 sensors to ensure cost-effectiveness and monitoring accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Grid Optimization Algorithm for Mold Flow Analysis to Improve Computational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient mold flow analysis algorithm based on adaptive grid optimization, aiming to improve computational efficiency and ensure result accuracy. The strategy of dynamically adjusting grid density is adopted to achieve local fine division by identifying key areas of the flow domain, which significantly reduces the computational redundancy of unnecessary areas. In the mold flow simulation of the FANUC industrial robot teach pendant shell, the experimental results show that the calculation time is reduced by about 38% after optimization, the filling time prediction accuracy is improved to more than 98%, and the pressure distribution error is reduced to 0.5%. At the same time, the reliability of the algorithm in predicting flow characteristics and defect locations is verified by visual analysis of flow field traces and pressure cloud maps. Compared with traditional methods, the algorithm in this paper significantly reduces the uncertainty of injection defect prediction while improving computational efficiency, showing broad prospects in industrial applications of complex models.

articleTitle: Image Restoration of Latent Diffusion Models Based on Compact A Priori Representation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Image restoration is the process of reconstructing the undesired part of an image by algorithm, which is one of the research hotspots in the field of computer vision. In this paper, for the problems of insufficient performance of denoising network and insufficient estimation of a priori information of image in Diffusion model for image restoration (DiffIR) model, the u-net network is improved to NAFNet and FreeU module is added. The performance of the denoising network in the diffusion model is effectively improved. Experimental results on Places and CelebA-HQ datasets show that compared with other models, the improved model in this paper leads about 0.5% and 3.1% in the evaluation metrics of LPIPS and FID, respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Joint Acoustic and Magnetic Underwater Target Detection and Tracking Models
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper analyzes and researches the problem of underwater target tracking in deep and distant water, and designs a joint acoustic-magnetic underwater target detection and tracking scheme with initial positioning of sonar buoys and precise positioning and tracking of magnetic detection drone in formation. Meanwhile, based on the FD (Flaming Datum) algorithm, a joint acoustic-magnetic underwater target detection and tracking model is established using Monte Carlo method, and the model simulation analysis is carried out for several variable parameters. The simulation analysis concludes that five variable parameters, namely, buoy detection error coefficient, number of magnetic detection drones, search speed of magnetic detection drone, search radius of magnetic detection drone, and target escape speed, have a large impact on the probability of underwater target detection, and can be combined with the capabilities of sonobuoys and magnetic detection drones to formulate a corresponding detection scheme for different target characteristics, so as to achieve efficient and fast detection results.

articleTitle: An Improved Remote-Center-of-Motion Control Algorithm and Application Feasibility Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraint is widely used in all kinds of ophthalmic surgery. The RCM system based on mechanical structure is too large and complex. While the way based on robot control solves these problems well and has better flexibility. Therefore, the research on RCM control is of great significance. In our work, an improved RCM control algorithm based on general robot is proposed, which is characterized by the progressive design of the coefficient of robot control increment, so as to achieve better compliance and stability. In order to verify the application feasibility of our improved RCM control algorithm, numerical simulation and simulation mapping experiments were carried out. The results show that the control process using the improved algorithm is more stable and reliable than the traditional way, and has good application feasibility and expansibility.

articleTitle: A study of the path optimization distribution problem with time windows
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Improved genetic algorithm is based on the traditional genetic algorithm, insert the large neighborhood search algorithm to solve the vehicle scheduling problem with time window (VRPTW). Establish the planning model with distribution cost as the optimization objective, take the actual store distribution problem of a supermarket as the research object, with the objective function of the least distribution cost, apply the improved genetic algorithm, traditional genetic algorithm to the model, compare with the traditional algorithm, the advantage of the improvement reduces the distribution cost, which is in line with the needs of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimization Algorithm for High Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic Access to Distribution Network Based on RNN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Conventional adaptive optimization algorithm for high proportion distributed photovoltaic access to distribution network mainly uses ARMA (Autoregressive moving average model) to obtain incremental load, which is vulnerable to the impact of centralized absorption fluctuation, resulting in poor algorithm optimization indicators. Therefore, an RNN based adaptive optimization algorithm for high proportion distributed photovoltaic access to distribution network is proposed. That is, RNN is used to build a high proportion distributed photovoltaic access distribution network model, and an adaptive optimization objective function of photovoltaic distribution network is designed to generate an adaptive optimization algorithm for distributed photovoltaic access distribution network. The experimental results show that the optimization performance indicators of the designed adaptive optimization algorithm for distribution networks are good, and the power supply capacity under different scenarios is the best, effective, and has certain economic value. It has made certain contributions to improving the centralized power supply capacity of distribution networks and reducing power supply and distribution losses.

articleTitle: Intelligent anti-jamming strategy for radar based on reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Radar in the process of work in the face of the complexity and variability of the jamming environment, with anti-jamming measures are difficult to exhaustive, due to the limitations of a priori knowledge and empirical knowledge, in the face of complex jamming pattern is difficult to ensure the quality of its anti-jamming. In this regard, the paper discusses different types of jamming signals, analyzes the mechanism of different types of jamming signals and carries out simulation. A reinforcement learning algorithm is introduced in the paper, and an intelligent anti-jamming strategy for radar based on reinforcement learning is proposed. The simulation results show that the intelligent degree of radar anti-jamming is effectively improved compared with the traditional anti-jamming strategy selection.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation and Recognition for Plunger Lift Based on Variational Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Plunger lift technology effectively addresses liquid loading issues in the later stages of natural gas well production. With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, the rapid identification of plunger data has become a challenge in field operations. Due to the lack of labeled field data and significant data imbalance, it is difficult to directly identify using discriminative models. This paper proposes a plunger lift generative model based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) for data augmentation of pressure data in plunger lift processes. The model maps original data through an encoder to obtain a high-dimensional latent variable probability distribution; the decoder maps the latent variable back to the real space to generate samples. The generated data supplements the original data, which is then input into a discriminative network for training. The results show that compared to the original discriminative model, the model’s performance indicators have improved after data augmentation.

articleTitle: Research on Low-Air-Pressure Megawatt-Level Thermal Environment Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the development of new trans-basin hypersonic vehicles, their flight altitude and velocity are significantly different from those of previous aircraft. The complex aerodynamic thermal characteristics due to high-altitude rarefied flows and self-jet counter-flow environments make the thermal environment increasingly severe. Consequently, in structural design, high-temperature-resistant composite materials like C/C and C/Sic with excellent mechanical properties under high temperatures are extensively used, but their thermal conductive behaviors vary greatly under low-pressure conditions. This necessitates a comprehensive approach beyond numerical simulation for product optimization; ground-based simulation tests are essential for evaluating effectiveness. This paper conducts research on heater structure design, thermal protection design, and discharge suppression arc design to develop a low-pressure megawatt-level thermal environment simulation system based on a graphite heating array. By leveraging the unique thermal response characteristics of the graphite heaters, we have developed compatible control programs that enable high heat flow (above 2MW/m2) simulation under low-pressure conditions with precise control capabilities. The successful completion of high-temperature performance tests for a specific model’s typical components segment showcases the system’s effectiveness and reliability in simulating complex thermal environments relevant to advanced aerospace applications.

articleTitle: Combining Multi-branch Pyramid Pooling Module and BiGRU for Human Energy Expenditure Estimation Using Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the increasing emphasis on Physical Activity Energy Expenditure (PAEE), many studies have proposed various methods to evaluate the energy expenditure. However, the low prediction accuracy restricts the wide application of these approaches. In this paper, we propose an innovative architecture that Combining Multi-branch Pyramid Pooling Module(PPM) and BiGRU for Human Energy Expenditure, called Multi PPM-BiGRU, which simultaneously utilize the acceleration data from multiple body locations. To evaluate our proposed model, extensive experiments are carried out using publicly available datasets from two distinct populations: the GOTOV dataset, consisting of data from older people, and the JSI dataset, consisting of data from young people. We compare our approach with existing approaches on different units. The experimental results demonstrate that our model can achieve better performance in terms of accuracy for the energy expenditure estimation.

articleTitle: Research on the hardware design of solar street light based on automatic light chasing technology
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This design utilizes a light-dependent resistor (LDR) and an STM32 microcontroller to work together for real-time solar tracking, optimizing solar energy capture. Combined with the 28BYJ-48 stepper motor control, it ensures that the solar panel is always aligned with the sun, maximizing energy absorption. The light sensor module monitors ambient light levels, intelligently controlling the on/off function of LED streetlights. Through the OLED display and ESP-01S module, data monitoring and remote management are achieved. This system not only improves the energy conversion efficiency of the solar panel but also stores excess energy in a lithium battery, ensuring lighting requirements are met during the night, enabling energy self-sufficiency. It is suitable for various outdoor locations, significantly reducing carbon dioxide emissions, contributing to environmental protection, and demonstrating the important value of energy saving and emission reduction. The system has a broad application prospect and promotion potential.

articleTitle: Machine-learning-based predictive classifier for sand body types and reservoir properties using geological data
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The classification and identification of reservoir sand body types has important research significance in oil-gas oilfield development plans. The traditional recognition method mainly relies on logging curves and manual recognition, which has the disadvantages of relying on expert experience and longtime consumption. This article is driven by geological data and compares various machine learning algorithms to select the intelligent algorithm suitable for solving this problem, achieving automatic recognition of reservoir sand body types and providing reference for reservoir engineering. The results show that the accuracy of the neural network algorithm reaches 97.4%, which can be used as an effective intelligent algorithm for reservoir sand body type classification and recognition.

articleTitle: Multi source information fusion self-updating Bayesian network weld seam recognition system
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article proposes a pipeline weld defect detection system based on multi detection information fusion, aiming to improve detection accuracy. By preprocessing and assigning confidence values to weld defect data, applying multi-source fusion Bayesian algorithm to improve detection accuracy, and optimizing recognition accuracy through self-updating Bayesian loop. The experimental results show that the system can efficiently and accurately detect and classify weld defects, with real-time and scalability, suitable for pipeline weld defect detection, and support engineering quality management.

articleTitle: High Temperature and High Pressure Direct Push Storage Logging System Applications and Improvements
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the increasing demand for developing complex oil and gas reservoirs such as shale gas and ultra-deep offshore wells, traditional logging technology is facing challenges such as high temperature and ultra-long well sections. This paper discusses the high-temperature and high-pressure direct-push storage logging system, which significantly improves the instrument's temperature, pressure, and mechanical strength through modularisation and integration design, and realizes real-time storage and efficient transmission of logging data Under the direct push mode, the operation process is simplified, the risk is reduced, the success rate and data quality are improved, and it is suitable for large inclined wells and horizontal wells. In response to problems in practical application, such as insufficient temperature resistance and low mechanical strength, improvement measures have been taken to upgrade the outer diameter of the instrument, design a new structure, and select high-temperature and durable devices, which have significantly enhanced the performance of the instrument. Meanwhile, the software function is upgraded to ensure the efficient matching of logging data and time-depth data. The technology has been applied in Qinghai, Tianjin, and other blocks with good results, achieving large-scale application. In the future, it will continue to improve the shortcomings of the technology, promote its wide application and sustainable development in the exploration of complex oil and gas reservoirs, and provide solid technical support for the industry.

articleTitle: Low complexity processing method for drilling attitude sensor faults
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the issues of high cost, complex system design, fragile redundant components, and heavy burden on the main controller in traditional attitude measurement while drilling (MWD) sensor fault handling methods, as well as the limitations of current high-complexity algorithms in downhole resources and real-time performance, a low-complexity fault handling approach based on sensor information redundancy is proposed. First, a fault diagnosis theoretical framework and fault tree model are established, focusing on the impact of sensor faults on attitude determination. Next, fault location is diagnosed using the fault tree model, and attitude solving is performed via an algorithm switching strategy to isolate faults and generate accurate attitude parameters. A fault code corresponding to the studied fault conditions is designed, and attitude calculation under sensor fault conditions is validated through hardware-in-the-loop simulation. Experimental results demonstrate that, under hard sensor faults, the proposed fault detection and treatment method ensures attitude calculation meets drilling requirements. Complexity analysis confirms the low computational complexity of the method, ensuring reliable attitude output with acceptable accuracy even under sensor failure.

articleTitle: Automatic Modulation Classification with Multi-modal Data Fusion Located at The Feature Layer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Since the widespread adoption of 5G technology, wireless communication systems have exhibited significant data throughput. Accordingly, the union of deep learning and wireless communication technology has become a major mainstream development direction. Automatic modulation classification (AMC) has the ability to aid 5G wireless communications by reallocating spectrum resources with low usage. As a result, it will play an increasingly important role in dynamic spectrum access. To improve the classification performance, a multitude of AMC techniques rooted in convolutional neural network prototypes and their variations have emerged in this field. However, many approaches rely solely on single-modal data from either sequence or image signals, disregarding the potential benefits of combining multimodal data for enhanced processing. To address this issue, we propose a multimodal fusion network (AMFN) for AMC. This network combines a convolutional neural network (CNN), a long and short-term memory network (LSTM), and two types of attention-based mechanism modules. Moreover, the network combines the features of sequence and image signal modes, enhancing the recognition ability of modulation signals by complementing each other. Experiment results demonstrate that the algorithm outperforms other related methods on the widely utilized public datasets RML2016.10A.

articleTitle: Arduino-based Desk Lamp System Design with Sitting Posture Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The radiation shielding system for wireless charging of substation inspection robots is designed to reduce or eliminate the electromagnetic radiation generated by the robot during wireless charging. This system plays a crucial role in ensuring the proper functioning of inspection robots and maintaining human health. Inspection robots in substations are usually based on the principle of electromagnetic induction for the transfer of electrical energy in wireless charging systems. Such a charging method releases electromagnetic radiation, which may adversely affect nearby equipment and the human body. With the radiation shielding system, we are able to reduce or completely eliminate electromagnetic radiation, thus ensuring the safety and stability of the operation of the inspection robot in the substation when it is charging wirelessly.

articleTitle: Identifying the primary factors influencing energy consumption in the water injection system through the use of fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To enhance and upgrade the current water injection systems in domestic oil fields, it is crucial to pinpoint the key factors that influence the energy consumption of these systems. This study introduces an approach utilizing the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to identify these critical factors. Initially, the energy flow within the water injection system is defined, and energy losses are segmented into three categories: pump unit loss, pipeline loss, and valve loss. Following this, the factors contributing to these three categories of energy losses are comprehensively analyzed, resulting in the creation of a hierarchical model of the factors impacting the energy consumption of the water injection system. By employing FAHP, this study proposes a method to ascertain the primary controlling factors of energy consumption in the water injection system through the development of the energy loss membership function and a fuzzy complementary matrix, ultimately calculating the overall weight values of each influencing factor. Empirical studies demonstrate that by constructing the hierarchical model of energy consumption factors and applying FAHP, the main controlling factors of energy consumption in the water injection system can be effectively identified, thus providing a scientific foundation for the optimization and enhancement of the water injection system.

Author Keywords: primary control factor of energy consumption

articleTitle: Robust Decision Making for Autonomous Vehicles at Lane-Merging Scenarios: A Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has demonstrated advanced ability to deal with complex decision making problems in autonomous driving. However, the driving demands (preferences) of passengers are hardly considered. In addition, the preferences usually change over time, how to balance these preferences still remain challenge for traditional DRL. In this paper, we present a multi-objective DRL approach considering dynamic preferences. Specifically, we model the sequential decision making problem with dynamic preferences for lane merging as markov decision process. Additionally, the random sampling with prior knowledge is advanced to reduce the sampling space and promote convergence rate. Finally, the homotopy optimization is introduced to avoid overfitting and balance the multiple preferences. We test the effectiveness of our algorithm in a lane-merging scenario. The results show that our method out performs the baseline method.

articleTitle: Signal level Test and research of while drilling Print Circuit Board Based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address accelerated failure and aging of key electronic circuits during drilling, a compact signal acquisition module has been designed for monitoring in limited underground space. Utilizing the dsPIC33EV128GM104 microprocessor and signal conditioning circuits, it processes measured signals and converts them with internal AD circuitry. The MCP2551 serves as the CAN transceiver for communication, allowing the module to transmit data to the host computer for real-time signal detection and status feedback, enhancing intelligent monitoring through high-speed and reliable data transmission.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Structural Optimization of Lift-Style Power Catwalk Based on ADAMS
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the jitter phenomenon occurring during the operation of the lift-type power catwalk, an ADAMS virtual prototype was established. A force analysis was performed to investigate the jitter issue at the transition point. Based on the analysis results, a structural optimization scheme was proposed. This optimization scheme was then validated through simulations in ADAMS. The experimental results show that, after applying the optimization scheme, the amplitude of the catwalk's jitter was reduced by more than a factor of four.

articleTitle: Positioning Accuracy Using UWB in Coal Mine Tunnel: Analysis and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: According to the principle and mechanism of UWB (Ultra Wide Band) positioning, the advantages and disadvantages of each realization method are analyzed with the coal mine tunnel as the background. In order to estimate the positioning accuracy using UWB in coal mine tunnel, the TOA (Time of Arrival) technique is selected to implement a MATLAB-based positioning simulation experiment. Through the analysis of the experimental data, it is concluded that the distance between the mobile tag and the base station has a significant impact on the positioning accuracy in a narrow space. As the tag moves away from the base station, the UWB positioning error increases.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Fitting String Energy Consumption in High Voltage Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In the current transmission system, the wire clamp of fittings uses aluminum alloy, while the rest is still steel. Due to the high resistivity of steel, it may lead to a large power loss. This study proposes to replace all the steel parts in the fitting with aluminum alloy, and compare the energy consumption change of the fitting before and after the replacement through theoretical calculation and simulation analysis. The results show that the conductivity of aluminum alloy is better than that of steel, which can effectively reduce the power loss and reduce the weight of the equipment. Furthermore, the effect of material replacement on the mechanical properties of the fittings is discussed in this study. The final conclusion shows that the use of aluminum alloy can improve the energy efficiency of transmission lines while maintaining the structural stability of the fittings.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Detection Method for Virtual Power Plant Measurement Data Based on Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the complexity and diversity of virtual power plants, there are often outliers in the measurement data, which may have a negative impact on the state estimation, optimization scheduling, and decision support of the power system. Therefore, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on the Isolation Forest algorithm. Clean and normalize the measurement data of the virtual power plant. Introducing the Isolation Forest algorithm, combined with the characteristics and requirements of virtual power plant measurement data, the dataset is randomly divided to construct multiple isolation trees, and the degree of data anomaly is determined based on the path length from data points to the root node. The experimental results show that this method can accurately identify most outliers while maintaining good recognition ability for normal data.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence of electrical conductivity on shock wave characteristics of spherical electrode
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The impulse sound source generated by the "hydro-electric effect" has great development potential in the fields of rock breaking, geosteering, location determination, hydro-electric forming, water treatment and oil and gas stimulation. At present, the research of impulse sound source is mainly based on the principle and application of the breakdown between electrodes when the electrodes are discharged underwater. In this paper, a numerical model of sphere-sphere electrode was established by COMSOL to study the effect of electrical conductivity on the impulsive wave property of sound source. The results show that with the increase of conductivity, the pre-breakdown delay decreases, the first peak of discharge current and the peak of shock wave intensity increase, the channel deposition energy decreases, the leakage energy and shock wave energy both increase, and the conversion efficiency of channel deposition energy to shock wave energy increases.

articleTitle: An improved ICP registration algorithm for 2D point cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In this study, an improved iterative closest point (ICP) registration algorithm was proposed to address such problems as great time consumption of iterative calculations and relatively large registration errors in the traditional ICP algorithm within the field of 2D point cloud registration. During the iteration process, the point-to-line (PL) objective equation was simplified to solve the linear least squares fast through singular value decomposition, etc. Subsequently, this result could be further nonlinearly optimized, and the weighted objective functions for the PL distance and point-to-point (PP) distance were introduced in the optimization process. Moreover, a simulation experiment was performed using point clouds that were randomly generated multiple times. The results reveal that the improved ICP algorithm proposed in this study can improve both the registration accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Fast feature selection algorithm of EEG data based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data is invaluable for investigating EEG physiology, neuroscience and clinical medicine. However, EEG signals are characterized by temporal nature, high dimensionality, and noise, which make it difficult for traditional feature selection methods for EEG data to extract useful information effectively with high computational effort. To solve this problem, this paper proposed a fast feature selection algorithm for multichannel EEG data based on a convolutional neural network (FFSEEG-GNN). Specifically, the algorithm pre-processes the multichannel EEG data, then extracts the waveform features and builds a CUDA architecture using GPUs to convolutional neural network operations. Finally, the most representative subset of features is selected in order of feature importance and feature extraction is performed. In addition, the simulation comparison experiment proves that the algorithm achieves 92.60% in terms of precision rate. Therefore, the program has accurate feature selection capability, which is expected to play an essential role in clinical medicine.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of a Ship Heading Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With China's rising status in global maritime affairs, the safety of ship operations, as the primary means of maritime transportation, has become increasingly prominent. Given that ships face multiple degrees of freedom of external disturbances while navigating at sea, leading to poor stability during voyages, this study selects seafaring vessels as its research subject. Based on Backstepping design theory and leveraging the characteristics of nonlinear control algorithms, it employs a reverse recursive approach to design a nonlinear heading controller suitable for ships. Through simulation verification, the precise control of the ship’s direction demonstrates the controller’s superior performance in maintaining a predetermined course in complex marine environments, highlighting its effectiveness in controlling nonlinear motion trajectories.

articleTitle: The modeling and simulation of PMSM basing on the sliding mode observer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The paper focus on the modeling, control and simulation method of permanent magnet synchronous motor-PMSM basing on sliding mode observer. To get the rotor speed without the sensor, firstly, the extended back electromotive force (EEMF) is estimated using voltage and current in the α-β coordinating system, and the control strategies are derived by selecting deliberately the sliding mode surface. Secondly, the input signals of the voltage and current in α-β plane approaches continuously and eventually coincides with the selected surface. Finally, the speed and position of the PMSM’s rotor are calculated based on the estimated variables to achieve control of the motor. To validate the feasibility of the method, a detail model with the speed/position observer was developed in Simulink. The comparisons with conventional position sensor confirmed that sliding mode observer exhibits good robustness and feasibility in PMSM control.

articleTitle: Attention-embedded multi-scale quadratic convolutional neural network for early bearing fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Bearings are vital components in various industries such as chemical, textile, food, and tobacco. Timely fault diagnosis is crucial for maintenance, performance, safety, and cost efficiency. Traditional methods rely on manual feature extraction and are time-consuming. This study proposes an attention-embedded multi-scale quadratic convolutional neural network (MQCNN) based on the attention-embedded quadratic network (QCNN). It utilizes an attention mechanism from quadratic neurons (qttention) to enhance noise resistance and automatically extracts frequency-specific signal features through varied convolution kernels and depths. This method improves diagnostic accuracy and offers significant economic advantages in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Identification of buried depth of steel bars in concrete based on GAF-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Reinforced concrete is widely used in the transmission of distribution networks due to its low cost and high reliability. When the internal steel structure is unreasonable or the steel quality does not meet the standards, the various properties of reinforced concrete will be greatly reduced, causing huge safety hazards. This paper takes concrete poles as the research object. Aiming at the current status of measuring the thickness of the steel protection layer in concrete, this paper proposes an off-line non-destructive detection method for the state of steel bars in concrete based on deep learning and pulsed eddy current. The time pattern of the received signal is explicitly encoded into different types of spatial images, namely Gramian Angular Fields (GAF), so that the convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to learn and classify the characteristics of the steel protection layer thickness measurement. A pulsed eddy current detection reinforced concrete model is built to collect the induced voltage changes due to the change of the buried depth of the steel bar, so as to verify the method in this paper, and it is concluded that GAF-CNN has good recognition accuracy in steel bar buried depth recognition.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Azimuthal Electromagnetic Wave LWD Instrument
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Azimuthal electromagnetic wave logging while drilling(LWD) is an important logging technique in modern oil and gas exploration. By measuring the electromagnetic wave response of the formation in real-time during the drilling process, parameters such as resistivity of the formation can be obtained, and key data such as porosity and oil saturation can be calculated, providing scientific basis for the evaluation and development of oil and gas reservoirs. This article will take the AWRT instrument as an example to explore in detail the principle, technical characteristics, application scope, and future development direction of the azimuthal electromagnetic wave logging instrument while drilling.

articleTitle: Characterization of the acoustic signals of the explosion of hand-held fireworks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of investigating fire incidents caused by fireworks explosions, we collected and analyzed the phenomena and acoustic signal features at different stages of the explosion process. First, acoustic data were captured in a laboratory for all phases of the fireworks explosion. Next, the collected data underwent framing, windowing, and short-time Fourier transform operations, resulting in the generation of waveform and spectrogram plots of the sound signals. Finally, we extracted the frequency characteristics of the fireworks explosion at different stages , concluding that: during the ignition phase, the sound is characterized by a faint hissing noise, accompanied by a few sparks, with the frequency spectrum primarily concentrated in the low-frequency range of 0-200 Hz, particularly featuring a distinct band around 180-200 Hz. During the stagnation phase, external acoustic and optical manifestations temporarily diminish. The ejection phase produces a short and crisp ejection sound, with the acoustic signals predominantly distributed in the 0-6 kHz frequency range, displaying a waveform envelope resembling that of a bullet. In the explosion phase, the waveform envelope takes on a conical shape, with the frequency spectrum concentrated in the 0-6 kHz range, especially highlighting distinct bands around 2 kHz and 4 kHz.

articleTitle: While-Drilling Circuit Board Test Data Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper designs a management system for while-drilling circuit board test data based on a MySQL database. The system is a unified Qt interface management tool that organizes and shares while-drilling circuit board test data. It uses a client/server (C/S) architecture, which enhances system response speed and separates data.The system includes functionalities for data uploading and downloading, as well as for creating, deleting, querying, modifying, and visualizing the data. Through integrated system construction and design, the system can structure and unify the management and analysis of the large volumes of data generated by while-drilling capacitor boards, ultimately facilitating easier maintenance and significantly improving security.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Fully Automatic Cement Conveying Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The cement conveying unit is a key component of well cementing operation equipment in the petroleum industry. However, it generally adopts the manual control strategy, thereby leading to large fluctuations in cement supply and even pipeline blockage. To overcome this shortcoming, this paper presents a fully automatic control system for stable cement conveying operation. This control system involves two tanks of the storage tank and the constant pressure tank and consists of four pressure control modules and two inventory control modules. For each control module, the control structure diagram is designed and the corresponding controller is constructed by using the proportional-integral control strategy. In order to validate the performance of the proposed control system, an industrial-scale pneumatic conveying experimental platform is built. The testing results on this platform show that the proposed fully automatic control system can effectively ensure the stable and controllable dense phase conveying of cement powder.

articleTitle: An Improved K-Means Radar Signal Pre-selection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The K-Means algorithm has a wide range of applications in radar signal pre-selection. Its traditional algorithm is highly dependent on the number of clusters and the initial setting of cluster centers, and is sensitive to noise and outliers. This article proposes an improved K-Means radar signal pre-selection method by introducing the Euclidean distance [1] operator in the clustering space and the category estimation method based on criterion functions. Simulation analysis shows that this method effectively reduces the sensitivity of traditional K-Means algorithm to noise and outliers, and improves the accuracy of radar signal pre-sorting.

articleTitle: Research on Quantity Traceability Method and Calibration Device of DIC Strain Field Measurement System Based on Laser Interference Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: At present, there is a lack of systematic calibration methods and traceability systems for non-contact 3D strain measurement systems. Based on the principle of laser interference, a method for traceability of DIC values was studied, and a strain calibration device was designed to generate a uniform two-dimensional strain field using material axial tension. By analyzing and compensating for the Abbe error in the deformation measurement process, and evaluating the standard uncertainty introduced by various influencing variables during the measurement process, the strain measurement results and corresponding extended uncertainty are finally obtained. The measurement uncertainty of the strain calibration device is U=1.4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">με</sup> ~2.1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">με</sup> (measuring range: 94.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">με</sup> ~945.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">με</sup>, k=2).

articleTitle: Image edge detection based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Image edge detection is a necessary work in object recognition, feature extraction and structure analysis. Firstly, an improved ant colony algorithm is proposed to solve the problems of partial path selection, low accuracy and low efficiency of traditional ant colony algorithm. The initial pheromone, heuristic function, pheromone update rule and state transition parameters of ant colony algorithm were improved. Finally, the experimental simulation verifies that two classical images are selected to carry out adaptive edge extraction, and the edge detection effect is compared with the traditional detection algorithm. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm can achieve complete and continuous image edge extraction, and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Application and Development of Oil Pipeline Magnetic Flux Leakage Detection Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to evaluate the condition of oil pipeline, the main nondestructive testing method currently used is magnetic flux leakage testing technology. The magnetic flux leakage data of pipeline are collected by magnetic flux leakage detector, and the magnetic flux leakage signal curve is drawn according to the data, and then the variation characteristics of the curve are judged manually to judge the defects on pipeline components. This method has great error and low efficiency. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, many magnetic flux leakage detection technologies based on machine learning algorithms have been proposed, which can realize more efficient and accurate intelligent detection. In this paper, the intelligent methods of pipeline magnetic flux leakage detection are summarized. At first, the basic principle of magnetic flux leakage detection is briefly introduced, and then the detection methods combining multiple physical fields and the methods using machine learning in pipeline magnetic flux leakage detection are emphasized in detail. Finally, the summary is made, and the problems that the intelligent methods still face are discussed.

articleTitle: Speech signal denoising based on GWO-VMD combined with MODWT
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To minimize the impact of noise on speech signals during transmission or recording. In this paper, a denoising method for speech signals is introduced, which integrates GWO-VMD with MODWT. Firstly, the combination of VMD decomposition parameters (k, α) is optimized using the GWO algorithm. The optimized VMD is used to decompose the signal and the IMF component with lower correlation coefficient is eliminated according to the correlation coefficient screening principle. Secondly, the remaining IMFs are recombined and multi-scale analysis is performed by MODWT. Finally, the wavelet coefficients with relative energy greater than a certain threshold are reconstructed to derive the denoised signal. Experimental outcomes demonstrate that by using GWO-VMD-MODWT for noise reduction, the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the original noisy speech signal has increased from -1.0416dB to 11.6057dB. The root mean square error (RMSE) has decreased from 0.0998 to 0.0233. The noise reduction capability of the integrated denoising method presented in this paper surpasses that of the single VMD and MODWT denoising method, as well as the classical EMD and EWT denoising method.

articleTitle: A weighted least squares approach for phase retrieval based on patch-wise noise level estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Phase measurement profilometry (PMP) is used in a wide range of 3D optical metrology applications. It is highly resistant to ambient light and object albedo, but it can be more prone to sensor and environmental noise. In this study, we present a novel approach for retrieving phase from noisy fringe patterns. Our method is based on weighted least squares (WLS) and noise estimation techniques. Firstly, we divide the noisy fringe patterns into overlapping patches. Then, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the patches, which allows us to effectively estimate the noise level and weight. We analyze the weight estimation and phase retrieval capability of our method concerning modulation, shift step, frequency, and size of the fringe pattern. We also provide simulation and experimental results to demonstrate the practical applicability of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Software and hardware design and implementation of vehicle controller
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The vehicle domain controller (VCU) is the core controller of the vehicle control, which realizes the management of the battery system, electric drive system, thermal management system, etc. through the vehicle bus or hard wire, including the control of gear, accelerator pedal and brake pedal, and calculates the torque control that needs to be output according to the real-time power battery power, and the control of the vehicle's low voltage and high voltage power up and down, energy recovery, etc. In recent years, our company has made efforts in the field of customized special new energy tractors. The existing VCU on the market makes it challenging to meet the customized needs of customers due to its closedness, so our company has developed a VCU according to the characteristics of target customers and mastered all related technologies from hardware circuit design to software code development, debugging, testing, etc., so as to facilitate the addition, deletion, and modification of customized functions for customers.

articleTitle: An Efficient ISAR Imaging Method of the Rotors of Small UAVs via Simplified CIRT
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The radar imaging of the rotors of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has great help to the detection and recognition of the UAVs. Most existing inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging methods can only obtain the image of the rigid body, whereas the study on the imaging of rotors is still facing challenges such as low resolution and heavy computational burden. In this study, a simplified complex inverse radon transform (CIRT) based method is proposed to reconstruct the images of the rotors with high efficiency. According to the characteristics of the rotor echoes, a parameterized phase matching based strategy is designed to estimate the initial phase angle of the rotor in the imaging interval. Then the sectors of interest in the imaging plane can be distinguished, so that the CIRT can be accelerated via sparse matrix calculations. Compared with traditional methods, the proposed method maintains the high imaging resolution and reduces the redundant calculations by taking full advantages of the rotor geometric characteristics. Experiments on simulated and measured data have verified that our proposed method can achieve high quality images of the rotors, and it takes only 40% of the memory and running time of traditional CIRT method.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Defect Recognition of Small Diameter Pipe Weld Seams Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The welding quality of small pipes directly impacts the safety and stable operation of engineering projects. X-ray non-destructive testing is an important method for assessing the welding quality of seams. To improve the efficiency and accuracy of radiographic inspection, this paper proposes a two-stage intelligent detection method for X-ray defects in small pipe weld seams. In the first stage, a lightweight modified YOLO network is employed to segment the images and extract regions of interest (ROI) where defects are concentrated. The second stage involves feature analysis of the images combined with sparse dictionary learning. Finally, the sparse dictionary matrix is utilized to accurately classify and differentiate between circular defects, linear defects, and noise. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively reduces the size of the network model, achieving a lightweight design, while the success rate for identifying circular defects is 0.974 and for linear defects is 0.967, thereby facilitating effective recognition of defects in small pipe weld images.

articleTitle: En-NBOR: An Enhanced Newton-Raphson-Based Optimizer for Underwater Acoustic Signal Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Underwater acoustic signals are frequently subject to noise interference during propagation, leading to signal attenuation and distortion, which present significant challenges for accurate reconstruction. This paper proposes an enhanced Newton-Raphson-Based Optimizer (NRBO) for underwater acoustic signal reconstruction, integrating three key innovations to improve accuracy and robustness. First, a Frequency-Domain Adaptive Newton-Raphson Search Rule enables adaptive adjustment of the search step size based on spectral characteristics, allowing detailed exploration in low-frequency ranges rich in signal content while quickly bypassing noisy high-frequency components, thereby enhancing reconstruction accuracy. Second, a Multi-Scale Feature Extraction with NRBO decomposes the acoustic signal into multiple scales, applies denoising and reconstruction independently at each scale, and then merges the results to preserve multi-level signal characteristics, improving overall signal quality. Finally, a Noise-Adaptive Objective Function dynamically adjusts weights according to noise levels in underwater environments, enhancing the algorithm’s denoising capability across diverse noise conditions. Experimental results show that the proposed method consistently outperforms traditional approaches in terms of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), reconstruction error, and convergence speed, demonstrating significant improvements in accuracy and robustness. This study provides an efficient and adaptable solution for underwater acoustic signal processing, suitable for various underwater environments.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection method of multidimensional carbon data in zero-carbon park based on GMM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: T=During the operation of zero- carbon park, accurate monitoring and analysis of multi-dimensional carbon data is the key to evaluate the effect of energy saving and emission reduction, optimize the energy utilization structure and improve the green development level of the park. However, due to the complexity and diversity of energy carbon data, abnormal data cannot be found and processed in time, thus affecting the green and low-carbon development process of the park. Therefore, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method of multidimensional carbon data in zero-carbon park based on GMM algorithm. The objective function of minimum carbon emission and minimum total operating cost for abnormal detection of multidimensional carbon data in zero-carbon park is constructed. According to this objective function, the constraint conditions of exchange power and energy balance in park operation are set, and GMM algorithm is introduced to realize abnormal detection of multidimensional carbon data in zero-carbon park. The experimental results show that this method can complete the anomaly detection of multi-dimensional carbon data in zero-carbon park, and the method has less missed detection times and better detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis and Test of Starting Characteristics of Light Source Module for Fiber Optic Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Start-up time of light source control system (light source + control circuit) have an import influence over quick response performance of fiber optic gyroscope. The system start-up characteristics are related to driver circuit in addition to light source. The system response speed and its stability can be accurately grasped by testing start-up performance of SLD light source control circuit designed for fiber optic gyroscope and analyzing the test results. It can be known from the test results that it takes around 2s from power-on to preliminary stabilization of optical power output.

articleTitle: Remote Intelligent Diagnosis Technology for Leakage Current Based on Smart Measurement Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As user-side loads become more complex, the safety risks associated with leakage currents have increased. Neutral-wire miswiring, a common incorrect wiring method, can cause abnormal leakage current detection, leading to inaccurate leakage status readings. Most existing research focuses on leakage current analysis under normal wiring, with little attention to the effects of improper wiring. This paper examines the characteristics of neutral and live wire currents, as well as leakage currents, under three common types of improper wiring. Using the DBSCAN clustering algorithm, abnormal leakage current data is identified and categorized into individual and clustered abnormal users. For these abnormal user clusters, improper wiring is detected through the relationship between neutral and live wire currents and a multiple linear regression model. The proposed method is validated with experimental data from a single-phase smart IoT energy meter.

articleTitle: Soliton solutions of the fifth order Caudrey-Dodd-Gibbon equation via a linear and nonlinear separate convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the fast progress of information technology, machine learning is getting increasing attention. Among them, there are a growing body of researches on learning partial differential equations (PDEs) via Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The linear and nonlinear separate network (LNSN) is a useful network for learning PDEs, and the Caudrey-Dodd-Gibbon (CDG) equation is an important PDE. As far as we know, the research on learning CDG equation via LNSN has never been documented. Therefore, we learn the CDG equation via the LNSN. In this work, we use the LNSN to learn one-soliton solution of the CDG equation. We compare results of one-soliton solution for the CDG equation via the LNSN under different time step sizes, training epochs, number of neurons per layer, and activation functions. It is found that the relative mean error (RME) can reach $\mathcal{O}\left( {{{10}^{ - 6}}} \right)$. Our experiments show the applicability of the LNSN for learning one-soliton solution of the CDG equation.

articleTitle: Acident report information extraction model based on ALBERT-BiGRU-CRF
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As global traffic accidents occur frequently, comprehensively understanding relevant information is particularly important. This not only helps identify potential safety hazards but also improves traffic infrastructure and management, thereby reducing the incidence of accidents. However, the effective extraction of key data such as time, location, and casualties from existing traffic accident texts still faces challenges and to address the low accuracy of traditional text extraction methods in extracting traffic accident information, this paper employs deep learning models for information extraction, aiming to mine effective information from traffic accident texts.First, we customized methods and identification standards for named entity recognition in traffic accidents to ensure the accuracy and consistency of the extraction. To mitigate the impact of data sparsity on model performance, we introduced a lightweight pre-trained model, ALBERT. This model generates high-quality embeddings that serve as input feature vectors for the Bi-directional Gated Recurrent Unit Conditional Random Field (BiGRU-CRF) model, enhancing the efficiency of entity feature extraction. Finally, we compared the extraction performance of this model with four other mainstream deep learning models. The results indicate that this model achieves an average accuracy of 0.94 in extracting information from traffic accident reports, demonstrating its strong extraction performance.

articleTitle: The Steel Defect Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5-CGC
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To address the issue of poor detection accuracy for small targets in steel surface defect detection, this paper improves upon YOLOv5 by integrating the Global Context (GC) Block with the C3 structure in the Backbone, resulting in a new feature extraction structure called C3GC. Additionally, the original Upsample operator is replaced with the CARAFE upsampling operator to enhance the model's ability to detect small targets. Results show that the improved YOLOv5-CGC algorithm achieved a mAP of 78.4% on the NEU-DET dataset, which is a 3.0% increase over the original YOLOv5. Detection accuracy for small targets, such as cracks and rolled-in scale, improved the most, with increases of 22.2% and 8.4%, respectively. Compared with mainstream detection algorithms, YOLOv5-CGC achieved superior performance.

articleTitle: Bridge Crack Detection System Design
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of traditional bridge crack detection and the problem of certain safety factors, this paper designs a bridge crack detection system based on machine learning. The system firstly carries out crack data collection and pre-processing, crack processing, classification and then crack parameter measurement, and finally integrates all the above steps into the GUI software interface. The whole system realizes the detection of bridge cracks and the display of parameters, and also gives the health condition of the bridge and suggestions. The design not only improves the efficiency of bridge crack detection, but also lays a good research foundation for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Temperature Performance Evaluation Method for Domestic HgCdTe Mid-Infrared Detectors
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Under the current environment of promoting localization, it is of great significance to study the temperature performance of domestic mid-infrared detectors for their development and performance optimization . A test method for the temperature performance of domestic HgCdTe mid-infrared detectors was proposed, and the performance of domestic detectors under different temperature conditions was investigated by quantitatively comparing them with imported high-performance detectors in terms of the temperature characteristics of dark current and response rate. The basic working principle of the mid-infrared detector was introduced, the mechanism of dark current and response rate variation with temperature was analyzed, and the principle and parameter settings of the blackbody radiation light source used in the experiment were explained. In the experimental part, the optical path system was constructed, domestic detector samples and imported detectors were selected for temperature experiments. The experimental data were analyzed and fitted to reveal the differences in dark current and response rate temperature characteristics between the domestic and imported detectors. The experimental results showed that the domestic detector samples had larger dark current and lower response rate compared with the imported detectors, and the temperature sensitivity performance was significantly worse. The results of this study provide a method for the performance testing of domestic detectors, and provide an important reference for the selection of detectors.

articleTitle: Inclination-holding Control Method for Rotary Steerable System Based on Fuzzy-PID
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As an urgent equipment for unconventional oil and gas development, Rotary Steerable System (RSS) plays an increasingly important role in oil and gas exploitation and other industrial fields. At the same time, in order to improve the drilling efficiency of tools and reduce the error interference caused by human operation, RSS needs to develop in the direction of downhole closed-loop automatic drilling and intelligence. This work focuses on downhole automatic inclination-holding drilling of RSS. Based on the Rotary Steerable System tool, a drilling tool simulation model is first established. Then, by using the deviation between the current inclination and the target inclination, the toolface angle is controlled, enabling the tool to drill or maintain along the target inclination. The control strategy used is fuzzy PID control method, and the control effect is better than the traditional PID control, which provides a new method for RSS intelligent control.

articleTitle: Cosine Similarity-Based Adaptive Weighting for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study investigates the application of adaptive loss weighting in the training of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to dynamically balance data, boundary, and physics losses. By employing cosine similarity of gradients, the proposed approach mitigates gradient dominance, ensuring more effective optimization. Numerical experiments on the Burgers equation demonstrate accelerated error convergence and enhanced training efficiency, underscoring its potential for tackling complex and high-dimensional physical systems.

articleTitle: Simulation research on electromagnetic pulse coupling surface current measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to accurately measure the surface current of the equipment under powerful electromagnetic environment, it is necessary to analyze the theory of surface current density and estimate the measurement method via comprehensive simulation. In this research, firstly, the basic principle of surface current measurement is given, then the field enhancement effect of the detector is analyzed. Based on the electromagnetic simulation software CST, the surface current density distribution of the metal shell is simulated, next, the uniformity of magnetic field on the surface of the shell is provided. Furthermore, it is verified that the existence of surface current detector will lead to field enhancement effect similar to the case of electric field measurement. The variables affecting the enhancement factor is simulated and analyzed in detail. Finally, a conclusion is given. This research can supply technical support for the manufacture and usage of surface current detectors.

articleTitle: Research on clearance detection method of safety mechanism of Three Gorges ship lift based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In view of the current situation of low efficiency, poor accuracy and inability to realize real-time detection of the clearance between the safety mechanism of the Three Gorges ship lift and the thread pair of the nut column, based on the machine vision detection technology, the data acquisition, camera calibration, thread edge line detection and nut column corner detection steps are adopted in turn. The pixel height difference is calculated by using the two midpoints in the image, and the midpoint position of the parallel line segment between the thread surface and the nut column is obtained. According to the camera imaging principle, the actual height difference is calculated to realize the real-time detection of the clearance between the safety mechanism and the thread pair of the nut column, the test shows that the error value of the gap detection is in the range of ± 2 mm, this detection method has engineering practical significance.

articleTitle: A modified LMS-Newton algorithm for multichannel active noise control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This research project is concerned with enhancing the efficacy of active noise control (ANC) systems, with a particular emphasis on the optimisation of the LMS-Newton algorithm. We introduce a novel method based on the unbiased estimation of the autocorrelation matrix and the dynamic adjustment of step parameters, which collectively enable the innovative development of a new form of the LMS-Newton algorithm. The performance of the algorithm was evaluated through simulation tests conducted under different noise conditions. The results demonstrate that, in comparison to the traditional LMS-Newton algorithm, the new algorithm has exhibited a notable enhancement in convergence speed and noise reduction capability. This research outcome paves the way for a new phase of advancement in ANC technology and has the potential to significantly improve the noise control level in related application fields.

articleTitle: The Reconstruction of Seismic Reflection Events by Optimized Matching Pursuit Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces an optimized matching pursuit algorithm for the reconstruction of seismic reflection events. It adopts intelligent optimization algorithms of genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm algorithm (PSO) to matching pursuit algorithm for improving the processing effect and efficiency. Through experiments on synthetic seismic records and field seismic data, it demonstrates that both GA-MP and PSO-MP can reconstruct the reflection events effectively and efficiency, while PSO-MP performs better especially in waveform reconstruction.

articleTitle: Research on Vapor Cell Geometry Effect of Rydberg Atomic Microwave Electric Field Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The Rydberg atom microwave electric field meter has many advantages over traditional methods of measurement in terms of accuracy, bandwidth and spatial resolution. The atomic vapor cell acts as a container for Rydberg atoms, different shapes and wall thicknesses also affect the distribution of microwave electric field in the cell. In this paper, the experimental principle of atomic microwave electric field meter is introduced first, and then the change of the spatial distribution of microwave electric field caused by atomic vapor cell with different shapes and wall thicknesses is studied by simulation, the influence of polarization direction of microwave electric field on measurement uncertainty is analyzed.

articleTitle: General Quality Characteristic Design of Low Field Quantum Resistance Standard
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: New low field quantum resistance standard solves troublesome issues of traditional quantum resistance standard, and meets the wide demand for high accuracy measurement of precision resistance in China, marks the development trend of quantum resistance. The new low field quantum resistance standard perfectly combines functional performance index and general quality characteristic index. General quality characteristic work implements the whole process of the product design, ensures the overall quality at the stage of product development and lays the foundation for subsequent production and commercialization.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman Filtering Using Quaternion Normalization for Attitude Measurement While Drilling
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Extended Kalman filtering (EKF) has extensively applied in attitude measurement while drilling, in which quaternion is commonly used as the state vector. However, for the dynamic model, the quaternion usually does not meet the requirement of the unit norm as time goes, which leads to the invalidity of attitude calculation. For this, this paper studies the EKF algorithm using normalized quaternion for attitude measurement while drilling. It establishes the state and measurement equations using quaternion according to specific rotation model of the drilling tool. Then, normalization is applied in each estimation step. Illustrative examples show the performance superiority of the method considered, compared with the method free of quaternion normalization and static calculation method.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing Real-Time Data Processing in High-Frequency Trading Algorithms using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: High-frequency trading (HFT) represents a pivotal and intensely competitive domain within the financial markets. The velocity and accuracy of data processing exert a direct influence on profitability, underscoring the significance of this field. The objective of this work is to optimise the real-time processing of data in high-frequency trading algorithms. The dynamic feature selection mechanism is responsible for monitoring and analysing market data in real time through clustering and feature weight analysis, with the objective of automatically selecting the most relevant features. This process employs an adaptive feature extraction method, which enables the system to respond and adjust its feature set in a timely manner when the data input changes, thus ensuring the efficient utilisation of data. The lightweight neural networks are designed in a modular fashion, comprising fast convolutional layers and pruning techniques that facilitate the expeditious completion of data processing and output prediction. In contrast to conventional deep learning models, the neural network architecture has been specifically designed to minimise the number of parameters and computational complexity, thereby markedly reducing the inference time.
