The experimental results demonstrate that the model is capable of maintaining consistent performance in the context of varying market conditions, thereby illustrating its advantages in terms of processing speed and revenue enhancement.

articleTitle: Research on Online Program Upgrade Method Based on TMS320F28388D
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: TMS320F28388D, as a new Digital Signal Processor (DSP) produced by Texas Instruments in recent years, has gradually been applied in various fields due to its strong performance. The official program update download method often requires opening embedded devices or configuring additional I/O status, which is not applicable in many scenarios. This article proposes an online upgrade method that does not require additional operations on embedded devices to address this issue. This method involves designing the BootLoader on the DSP side and the software on the personal computer side separately. The BootLoader is solidified to the DSP, and then the update file is automatically downloaded to the DSP using a personal computer via serial communication. Finally, the feasibility of this method was verified on the development board.

articleTitle: Research on face tracking system based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Some surveillance equipment can detect faces, but when the face is not in the picture, or when the face is incomplete there may be a comparison error, in order to reduce this comparison error requires the camera to track the face in real time, and subject to cost, technology and other issues, nowadays face tracking technology is less used in these devices. Therefore, this paper proposes a low-cost face recognition and tracking system, so that the YOLOv5 algorithm and trained face data set to, combined with the STM32 core board and servo to realize, face recognition and tracking. The realization results show that. The accuracy of face recognition reaches 95% and can accurately recognize faces in the corresponding database.

articleTitle: Using Multi-scale Detection Mechanism and Dynamic Monitor Defect Area for Pipeline Weld Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: To effectively detect weld defects of various sizes, particularly small defects that are often overlooked and result in low detection accuracy, we propose a method for pipeline weld identification and dynamic monitoring of defect areas based on a multi-scale detection mechanism. This paper introduces multi-scale feature extraction, an Enhanced Multi-scale Attention (EMA) mechanism optimizer into the X-ray weld defect detection network. These enhancements aim to improve the model’s ability to capture features at different levels, address information loss from channel dimensionality reduction, and enhance the detection of both large targets and subtle details critical for identifying small defects. The model successfully identifies various weld defect types. Additionally, edge detection is employed to calculate the physical area of the cropping regions and non-edge areas, enabling the extraction of weld defect areas. Cubic spline smoothing is used to model the trends in defect area changes and predict the lifecycle of the pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate that this method effectively detects small and complex weld defects in real-time, achieving precision and recall rates of 96.9% for scratches and 90.4% for incomplete fusion. Furthermore, the correctly identified defects and the dynamic monitoring of defect areas provide a valuable decision-making framework for the safe operation and preventive maintenance of oil and gas pipelines.

articleTitle: Pinning Synchronization of Fractional-Order Complex Networks With Multi-State Couplings
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the synchronization problem for multiple-state coupled fractional-order complex networks (MSCFOCNs). On one hand, a sufficient condition for ensuring that MSCFOCNs can achieve synchronization is obtained on the basis of inequality techniques, Laplace transform and an appropriate node-based pinning scheme. On the other hand, we not only construct the edge-based pinning control strategy, but also take synchronization for MSCFOCNs into consideration. Eventually, numerical example is given to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Inversion Method of Transient Electromagnetic Logging Based on Wavefield Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The theory of traditional inversion methods of transient electromagnetic data is relatively complex and the accuracy is not high, so a transient electromagnetic logging inversion method based on wave field conversion is proposed to study. There is a conversion relationship between the time-domain magnetic field and the virtual wave field, and the magnetic field data calculated by numerical simulation through finite element software is converted into the virtual wave field information. The virtual wave field characteristics are related to the electrical parameters of underground media, so the inversion of transient electromagnetic logging can be realized.

articleTitle: Threshold Selection for Circuit Board Nodes Based on LSTM Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the advancement of modern electronic integration technology, the complexity of circuit board composition has significantly increased, making fault detection more challenging. This study proposes a fault diagnosis method based on the current and voltage test values of circuit nodes. By setting up test points on the circuit board, the method determines whether the board is functioning correctly by evaluating if the test values fall within the specified thresholds. Leveraging existing circuit board test data, the study first performs data cleansing, followed by sliding window processing. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks are then employed to predict the test values for each window, and the 3σ method is used for conditional judgment to derive appropriate thresholds. This approach enhances detection accuracy and the ability to identify subtle anomalies, thereby significantly improving the reliability and precision of circuit board fault detection without damaging the circuit board.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of multi-pulse echo for an airborne altimeter radar
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to solve the complicated modeling problem of spin motion of a given sort of aircraft, a new spin motion model is built in this paper.The variation rule of radar irradiation area is obtained based on this model. Then, this paper establishes the radar echo model by using grid division method to divide the illuminated area. The multi-pulse echo is simulated based on the model. After analysis, it is concluded that radar multi-pulse echo will be modulated by Doppler frequency and show multiple periods.

articleTitle: An Attention-based LSTM price prediction model based on a single time series information
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards, people's income from work has gradually increased, and their remaining savings have also gradually increased. In order to avoid the problem of currency devaluation and shrinking savings caused by inflation, investment is regarded as an indispensable asset allocation method. Among investment products, gold has always been favored for its store of value; in the past decade, the cryptocurrency Bitcoin has been limited in number due to its unique technology, causing a new wave of investment in Bitcoin. At present, most of the existing forecasting models are for forecasting stock prices, and there are multiple forecasting models. We used grayscale prediction, time series analysis method and LSTM prediction model based on Attention mechanism to predict and analyze the results of two investment products. The experiment found that the LSTM prediction model based on Attention mechanism had the best prediction performance of the two investment products.

articleTitle: Autocalibration for MEMS triaxial accelerometer based on a PID-based search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The errors can accumulate over time when microelectromechanical system (MEMS) accelerometers are in use, it is necessary to perform autocalibration to remove the systematic error effect. However, little research has been done on simultaneously considering the non-orthogonality and misalignment effect in MEMS triaxial accelerometer calibration. To enhance the calibration accuracy and extend the autocalibration methods, this paper proposed a new autocalibration method for MEMS triaxial accelerometers base on a PID-based search algorithm. Non-orthogonality and misalignment error factors were integrated into the error model and a PID-based search algorithm was developed to identify the optimal error factors, minimizing the difference between the actual accelerometer output and the local gravity. The proposed calibration method was tested through simulations, with results showing that the errors in scale factor, bias, non-orthogonality, and misalignment are within 1.5865×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, 2.0060×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, 5.0621×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, and 6.8104×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, respectively. The proposed method was also compared with the existing calibration methods, with the maximum errors of the proposed method within 0.41% and those of the others exceeding 0.80%. Simulation and comparison results verified the effectiveness and improvement of the proposed method. The average time of the autocalibration is 13.22 s, offering practical value for MEMS triaxial accelerometers.

articleTitle: IMU Accelerometer Data Fitting Method for Attitude Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A nonlinear least squares optimization method based on time series has been proposed to address the issue of errors in the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) accelerometer under high-frequency operating conditions during bead frame and nozzle attitude following monitoring. By combining the trajectory of the rigid body and the curve of acceleration data, a nonlinear model of the acceleration data curve is first fitted using the Lomb-Scargle method; then, the nonlinear least squares optimization method is used to obtain the optimal nonlinear model; finally, the acceleration values derived from the model are used to calculate the attitude of the rigid body. The experimental results shown that, compared to the traditional method of error compensation for acceleration data, the method of fitting the acceleration data curve can effectively avoid the impact of noise and data drift on the acceleration data, while also improving the precision and stability of the calculated attitude angle.

articleTitle: Crack detection of external wall insulation materials based on infrared polarization imaging and Otsu threshold segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Due to the multi-texture and multi-objective characteristics of the surface of external wall insulation materials, the existing crack detection methods can not meet the detection needs in real time. Therefore, this paper proposes a crack detection method for external wall insulation materials based on infrared polarization imaging and Otsu threshold segmentation. Under infrared polarization imaging and Otsu threshold segmentation, the characteristics of cracks in external wall insulation materials are extracted, and the cracks are classified according to the extraction results, which are divided into connection cracks between concrete structural columns, connection cracks between insulation boards and boards, vertical cracks in the middle of the whole wall, 45 inclined cracks, cracks on the wall surface, temperature cracks and shortening cracks. Obtain the number of pixels in the crack area, calculate the distribution density of the crack image of the external wall insulation material, set the target area based on the Otsu threshold, and when the data stops iterating, take the current result as the final crack detection result, that is, complete the crack detection of the external wall insulation material. The experimental results show that the method in this paper has high accuracy in detecting cracks, and it shows high crack resistance index and good detection performance when dealing with all types of cracks.

articleTitle: Algorithm for fire detection and 3D point cloud data fusion construction under deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Fire in high-rise buildings is a major hidden danger that threatens people's lives, and in order to know the fire situation, this paper proposes to utilize the optimized YOLOv11 model to accurately identify the flames and smoke, and to use 3D LIDAR to construct point cloud maps of high-rise buildings in real time. Through the high-definition camera and 3D LiDAR to achieve the fire and environment map construction, and the fire information mapped to the 3D map to achieve the three-dimensional visualization of fire information. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm improves the accuracy and F1 score by 1 percentage point compared with the original, and the fused point cloud map has high imaging fineness and complete information.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System for Nuclear Power Terminal Blade Vibration Based on Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The working condition of steam turbine is changeable, the shape of its last stage blade is distorted, the spatial structure is complex, and the flow field in its flow passage is complex. So there are many problems in the fault monitoring and diagnosis of the last stage blade of steam turbine. The traditional run-test-repair process can not find defects online. In order to keep the workload of off-line maintenance and testing to a low limit, In this paper, a tip timing system is constructed to monitor the last stage blades of nuclear steam turbines. An advance spectrum analysis technology is adopted to carry out real-time acquisition and analysis on that vibration signal of the blade, Comparing the extracted blade vibration information with the fault feature information in the database, So as to accurately judge the cause, degree, type, location and other information of the blade fault.

articleTitle: Scanning Electron Microscope Image Data Acquisition and Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) has emerged as a pivotal tool in scientific research and engineering, offering unparalleled insights into the micro- and nano-scale world. However, traditional SEM systems often entail bulky setups and complex data acquisition processes, limiting their accessibility and efficiency in various applications. This paper designs a desktop SEM image data acquisition and transmission system based on FPGA. The system is divided into two parts: signal modulation and AD sampling circuit and image data processing and transmission circuit. By designing a circuit to process SE/BSE signals, signal modulation and analog-to-digital conversion are achieved. The sampling data is processed using the internal resources of the FPGA and transmitted to the PC through the USB3.0 high-speed interface, and finally displayed as a grayscale image. The system realizes real-time collection, processing and transmission of SEM signals, providing convenience and efficiency for scientific research and engineering applications. Experimental verification shows that the system performs well and has certain application potential.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Temperature Control of UAV Nest Inverter Air Conditioning Based on Variable Air Volume and DE Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The current temperature control model of UAV nest inverter air conditioning energy saving is mostly set to a single scheduling form, and the control efficiency is relatively low, resulting in a decline in the final energy consumption optimization ratio. Therefore, the design and practical verification of the temperature control method of UAV nest inverter air conditioning energy saving based on variable air volume and DE algorithm are proposed. According to the current measurement, the dynamic balance adjustment of the air volume and frequency of variable frequency air conditioning is carried out first. Based on this, the change trend of the thermal load of the UAV nest is analyzed. On this basis, combined with variable air volume and DE algorithm, the efficiency of control is strengthened, and the energy-saving temperature control model of UAV nest inverter air conditioning with variable air volume and DE algorithm is established, and the multi-level real-time balance correction method is used to achieve temperature control processing. The test results show that compared with DFT central air conditioning control method and deep learning intelligent energy-saving air conditioning control method, the energy consumption optimization ratio finally obtained by the variable air volume and DE calculation UAV machine nest variable frequency air conditioning energy-saving temperature control method is relatively high, which indicates that this time, with the help and support of variable air volume and DE algorithm, the designed energy-saving temperature control method of UAV nest inverter air conditioning is more flexible and changeable, and its own temperature control effect has been further improved, and the results have been verified in practice.

articleTitle: FMCW Height Measurement System for Complex Urban Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: A Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) height measurement system designed for complex urban environments is presented, employing a single-antenna structure, multi-threshold OS-CFAR algorithm, and weighted smoothing filtering techniques. The system enhances anti-interference capability and measurement accuracy. The single-antenna structure optimizes signal transmission and reception processes, achieving system miniaturization and high adaptability. The multi-threshold OS-CFAR algorithm utilizes segmented detection and adaptive parameter adjustment to effectively suppress the effects of multipath interference and Rayleigh fading, improving false target suppression rates by approximately 25%. Weighted smoothing filtering reduces Doppler-induced errors by integrating multiple measurement results, limiting the measurement error to within 0.5 m. Experimental results confirm the system's high stability and accuracy in complex environments, providing reliable technical support for height measurement in low-altitude navigation and obstacle detection.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis Method for Geographical Environmental Changes Based on Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study develops a sensitivity analysis method for geographical environmental changes in a typical region of the Yangtze River’s middle reaches. A support vector machine (SVM) model was used to assess the influence of factors such as slope, precipitation, and land use on environmental sensitivity. Key factors were screened and weighted using principal component analysis and recursive feature elimination. Model parameters were optimized with grid search and Bayesian techniques. Results highlight land use intensity and slope as primary drivers of regional sensitivity, with urbanization notably impacting spatial sensitivity distribution. Cross-validation demonstrated strong model accuracy and applicability for environmental sensitivity prediction.

articleTitle: Trajectory Prediction for V2X Collision Warning Using Pruned Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This study explores the use of a pruned Transformer model for vehicle trajectory prediction in V2X collision warning systems, focusing on balancing accuracy and computational efficiency. By employing weight pruning, the model significantly reduces parameters and inference time while maintaining competitive performance with traditional LSTM models. Real-world experiments across diverse traffic scenarios demonstrate the pruned Transformer’s strengths in trajectory prediction error and false warning rates. However, increased missed warnings in dynamic scenarios and longer prediction times highlight areas for further optimization. These findings establish the pruned Transformer as a promising candidate for real-time V2X applications under resource constraints.

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification of Navigation on Pilot Algorithm for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Built a software in the loop simulation and verification platform of navigation on pilot algorithm based on the tool chain of VTD, Carsim and Simulink, to solve the difficult problem of simulation and test of the algorithm, because the necessary input signal for the algorithm include complex and hard-to simulate high-definition maps and navigation signals.The simulation driving data from the simulation software and the map and navigation data generated by the map simulation program were used to activate the algorithm and make it run stably. Test cases and function evaluation indexes were designed for the four basic functions of the algorithm as cruise, vehicle follow, brake stop and lane change, and each use case was tested three times. The results show that the algorithm could stably control the vehicle to perform four basic functions, and all the operation data of the vehicle met the functional requirements of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Return to zero coded Gaussian minimum shift keying for wellbore electromagnetic wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Electromagnetic wireless communication in oil and gas wellbores faces challenges such as high bit error rates, limited channel bandwidth, and power constraints. Traditional digital modulation methods struggle to balance error performance with the power spectrum characteristics required for effective communication in these environments. To address this issue, we propose a Return to Zero coded Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying modulation method, based on GMSK with a BT value of 0.3. This method utilizes a bipolar return-to-zero code with a 70% duty cycle for differential encoding of the original signal, which serves as the input to a Gaussian filter. It mitigates the high bit error rate caused by inter-symbol interference in conventional GMSK while maintaining excellent power spectrum characteristics. The simulation results indicate that the modulation method proposed in this paper can simultaneously satisfy the requirements of oil and gas wellbore communication on the bit error rate performance and power spectrum characteristics, which further improves the reliability and effectiveness of oil and gas wellbore communication. Experimental results from wireless signal down-transmission in a real wellbore environment confirm that the RZ-GMSK signal can accurately transmit control instructions, meeting the needs of field operations.

articleTitle: Daily behavior recognition of cattle in complex environments based on improved YOLOv8s
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of inconsistent target scales in the task of daily behavior recognition of cattle in farms due to the complex environment of farms, large changes in illumination, and the uneven distribution of cattle, a method based on the improved YOLOv8s is proposed for the recognition of daily behavior of cattle. By testing on the self-constructed dataset, the average accuracy mean mAP of the improved ELID-YOLOv8s network reaches 85.3%, which is 3.0% higher than the original network model YOLOv8s. Therefore, the method in this paper can significantly improve the recognition accuracy of cattle behavior in different environments, different lighting and multi-scale conditions.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm for regional cattle population counting under local optimal methods
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: As a movable collateral, live cattle need to be accurately counted and recorded on a regular basis, such as their breeds, numbers and other important information. Aiming at the problems that the existing cattle number detection algorithms have leakage detection phenomenon for dense and small targets and have many parameters and large computation volume, which are not suitable to be deployed at the end of embedded devices, a CBG-YOLOv5s cattle number detection algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the improved model reduces the number of parameters and computation by 37.32% and 43.04%, respectively, compared with the original model YOLOv5s, and still maintains good detection accuracy. Finally, the lightened model was successfully deployed to Nvidia Jetson Nano mobile and verified by actually running on the development board. The model in this paper is able to ensure the accuracy of cattle identification, which can provide a reference for the accuracy of detecting the number of cattle in complex farming environments and under severe occlusion conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Detection of Well Control Manifolds Based on Multi-Instrument Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-instrument data fusion model based on hybrid article warm optimization and kernel extreme learning machine for the problem of defect detection in offshore drilling well control manifolds. The principles of well control manifold defect detection are studied, and the characteristics of defect detection for individual instruments are analyzed. Ultimately, three types of precision instruments suitable for detecting well control manifold defects are optimized.Combining the output parameters of the instrument, the final determination is made using the coordinate positions x, y of the defect, as well as the defect size dimensions of length, width, and wall thickness as the input feature parameters for the data fusion model, with the model's output being the regression values for each feature parameter.The experimental analysis compared this model with classical extreme learning machines, kernel extreme learning machines, and ordinary particle swarm optimization-based kernel extreme learning machines. The results indicate that the model based on hybrid particle swarm optimization for kernel extreme learning machines has superior accuracy and generalization capabilities compared to the other models.

articleTitle: Motion Is All You Need
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The integration of digital tablets and smart pens has revolutionized handwriting tasks in various domains, yet current solutions like the Apple Pencil necessitate specialized touchscreens, escalating costs and limiting accessibility. This study introduces a novel motion-based handwriting recognition system that eliminates the dependency on touchscreens by utilizing motion data alone, enabling handwriting capture on any surface. Our primary contributions include the design of an all-in-one, 3D-printed smart pen prototype equipped with an inertial measurement unit (IMU) for precise motion sensing, and the creation of a comprehensive handwriting motion dataset comprising 6,500 samples of lowercase English characters. We developed end-to-end machine learning algorithms, specifically a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D CNN) and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, to accurately recognize handwritten characters from the captured motion data. Experimental results demonstrate that our LSTM model achieves a test accuracy of 90.46%, significantly outperforming previous motion-based recognition systems. This work validates the feasibility of motion-only handwriting recognition and presents a cost-effective alternative to touchscreen-dependent smart pens, potentially broadening the accessibility of digital handwriting technologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing RFID based human activity recognition through spatiotemporal feature construction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: This article proposes a new method that significantly improves the accuracy of action recognition based on RFID systems by introducing advanced spatiotemporal features and utilizing spatiotemporal graph convolutional networks (ST-GCN). Traditional RFID motion recognition models often struggle to capture the subtle spatial and temporal relationships between joint movements, resulting in limited recognition accuracy in complex activity scenarios. To overcome this issue, we propose a new feature construction method that utilizes new signal features derived from RFID signal data (including RSSI, Doppler frequency, and phase), such as velocity, acceleration, phase change rate, and RSSI change rate. These features can finely capture the dynamic changes in time and space, thereby improving the performance of the model in distinguishing complex actions. The experimental results show that the ST-GCN model trained on enhanced feature sets significantly improves the accuracy of action recognition tasks, verifying the effectiveness of our method. In addition, feature construction methods have played a key role in improving the identification ability of RFID signal data, especially in distinguishing similar actions in complex environments, demonstrating their broad potential for application in behavior analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of High-Precision Ionospheric Delay Model for the Guangdong Region
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The high-precision positioning technology of the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) is a key support for intelligent drone inspections. However, in the low-latitude region of Guangdong Province, ionospheric activity is frequent and intense, and the correction accuracy of existing Global Ionospheric Maps (GIM) is insufficient in this area, often leading to significant positioning deviations during drone inspections. Therefore, this paper proposes an ionospheric delay correction method based on the Satellite-based Ionospheric Model (SIM). This method first employs carrier phase-smoothed pseudorange techniques to precisely extract the Total Electron Content (TEC) from dual-frequency GNSS observation data. Based on this data, a low-order polynomial model is independently established for each satellite, achieving accurate TEC correction and effectively avoiding the errors introduced by traditional mapping functions. Using empirical data from multiple Continuous Operating Reference Stations (CORS) in the Guangdong power grid, the results show that the SIM model significantly improves the correction accuracy of ionospheric delays, particularly in regions and periods of intense ionospheric activity. Under moderate solar activity conditions, the SIM model demonstrates stable correction accuracy, with a daily average bias of 0.1463 TECU and a standard deviation (STD) of 0.9192 TECU. Under high solar activity conditions, the daily average bias and standard deviation increase to 0.1469 TECU and 1.1937 TECU, respectively, indicating good adaptability and a much higher accuracy than GIM. The model also shows similar excellent performance in both winter and summer, confirming its strong environmental adaptability and stability. This provides an effective new solution for high-precision GNSS positioning and ionospheric delay correction in low-latitude regions.

articleTitle: A New Multi-Parameter Measurement System for Analyzing Phase Change Dynamics in Phase Change Thin Film Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Chalcogenide phase change materials (PCMs) are emerging as prime candidates for phase change random access memory, due to their pronounced differences in reflectivity and resistivity between amorphous and crystalline states, as well as their capacity for rapid state switching. In the design of PCMs, especially superlattice-like PCMs, their complex change laws need to be characterized and understood from different properties. This paper presents a new measurement system that combines the in-situ resistance measurement and wafer curvature method to achieve synchronized common measurements of resistance, reflectivity, and stress. Additionally, an advanced source measure unit module and a self-developed multi-channel expansion module are designed to realize simultaneous precise multi-channel resistance measurements for fast batch testing. articleTitle: Infrared small target detection based on long-short term frame difference algorithm(LSTFD)
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: According to the characteristic that the position change of small infrared target in sequence images is more obvious than background and noise, an infrared small target detection algorithm based on multi-frame time domain information is proposed, called the Long-Short Term Frame Difference (LSTFD) algorithm. The algorithm first adopts the SURF (Speeded Up Robust Feature) alignment strategy to eliminate the relative motion of background pixels caused by camera shake and achieve global motion compensation. Then, the image sequence is constructed based on the current frame, and the computational results of long-interval difference and short-interval difference are combined to detect the infrared small targets. The experimental results show that the LSTFD algorithm can accurately detect moving targets with high detection accuracy and low false alarm rate under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio. And the average detection rate can reach over 90% on five sets of experimental data.

articleTitle: Research on Non-destructive Testing Technology for Downhole Casing Based on Constant False Alarm Rate Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The uniform linear multi-coil array (ULMA) has been successfully utilised for non-destructive testing of downhole casing. However, the narrow and complex detection environment underground limits the degrees of freedom of the ULMA system, thereby affecting its detection efficiency. Aiming to enhance the detection performance of ULMA in complex noise environments, this paper proposes a non-destructive testing technology for downhole casing based on constant false alarm rate (CFAR) processing. This technology establishes an array signal model for downhole casing non-destructive testing by analysing the structural characteristics of transient electromagnetic signals in the borehole and employs the linearly constrained minimum-variance (LCMV) algorithm to correct the phase offset of the array signals, enhancing detection reliability. By setting reasonable detection thresholds and combining them with CFAR processing criteria, real-time and accurate detection of casing damage is achieved. In the experiments, we built a downhole transient electromagnetic detection system using ULMA and validated the effectiveness of the proposed method through simulations of non-destructive testing of oil well casings.

articleTitle: The Application of Spectral Subtraction and Calman Filtering for Audio Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Spectral subtraction is a spectrophotometric determination method for content measurement that eliminates interfering components through mathematical processing. It obtains a pure signal by subtracting the spectrum of noise. If we assume that the noise is additive and, through short-time spectral analysis, considers the spectrum to be stable over short periods. By calculating the spectrum of noisy speech and the noisy spectrum, the spectrum of pure speech can be obtained. Spectral subtraction is widely used in the field of speech denoising due to its simplicity and fast processing speed. For example, in real-time voice communication, spectral subtraction can effectively remove background noise and improve speech quality. The main drawbacks of spectral subtraction include the generation of "musical noise", which may lead to rough speech quality. Therefore, further methods such as hybrid spectral-Kalman filters have been proposed by combining Kalman filtering techniques, achieving better performance. This paper reviews and compares the application of spectral subtraction and Kalman filtering for noise reduction in complex noise environments, and points out future research challenges and directions.

articleTitle: Gravity stability mechanism and prediction model for natural gas injection flooding in multi-layered, heterogeneous reservoirs with high dip angles
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The mechanism of gravity-stable flooding with top gas injection differs significantly from that of thick-layer homogeneous reservoirs owing to the strong intra- and interlayer heterogeneity in high-dip reservoirs. This study analyzes the geological characteristics of the LBIV oil group, assesses the basic displacement mechanism through the minimum miscibility pressure test of crude oil in reservoirs, and evaluates the displacement efficiency from water flooding to gas flooding using long-core analysis. The stability mechanism of secondary gas top injection is thoroughly examined by combining two-dimensional profile physical and numerical simulations. Using the dynamics of the gas injection test group as a reference, a relationship equation for a comprehensive prediction model of gravity-stable flooding of top gas injection, based on the Dietz model, is proposed along with a method for predicting gas–liquid interface. This prediction method considers various factors, including injection-production patterns, well spacing, elevation differences between injection and production wells, reservoir rhythm, and injection–production ratio. The results show that the comprehensive relationship effectively reflects the influence of stable flooding engineering and geological parameters of artificial gas caps, accurately predicts the displacement dynamics of artificial gas caps under different parameter combinations, and precisely analyzes the dynamics of gas storage construction.

articleTitle: Modeling of Magnetic Anomaly Signals for Underwater Unexploded Ordnance MK13 and MK26
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Detecting and identifying underwater unexploded ordnance is vital for the safety of marine engineering constructions. This study constructs models of MK13 and MK26 mines based on their physical dimensions and ferromagnetic characteristics. Static detection tests were performed on the mine models using a G882 magnetometer under various conditions, calculating the models' magnetic moments and simulating the three-dimensional distribution of the mines' magnetic anomaly signals in space via MATLAB. Comparing actual and simulated signals reveals that both are fundamentally similar in shape, with slight discrepancies in signal distance and a maximum amplitude difference of about 20%. The findings validate the model's accuracy and demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of magnetic detection technology, providing crucial parameters for underwater UXO detection projects.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Control of High-Pressure Common Rail Fuel Injection Volume Based on Fuel Injection Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: In order to improve the traditional open-loop control of the high-pressure common rail system based on the calibration MAP diagram, a PI closed-loop control system of the injection volume based on the fuel injection observer is proposed and designed. According to the fuel flow law and the rail pressure fluctuation characteristics, a fuel injection volume observer based on rail pressure fluctuation was established. And then a closed-loop PI controller for the fuel injection volume was designed based on the observation of fuel injection volume as feedback. In view of the constrain of the control signal limiting, the structure of PI controller was improved. In addition, in order to ensure the control performance under a wide range of working conditions, the neural network algorithm was applied to predict the controller parameters under multiple working conditions. The performance of the control system was verified by co-simulation. The results show that the error of the observed fuel injection volume is less than 3% compared with the actual value. The designed system can suppress disturbances and successfully achieve closed-loop feedback control of fuel injection volume.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Factors Affecting the Decoding Success Rate of High rate Shear Valve Pulser
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: The "Xuanji" system is a revolutionary drilling technology independently developed by China Oilfield Services Limited(COSL). It is composed of two major technologies, namely rotary steering drilling "Welleader" and logging while drilling "Drilog", and has currently achieved large-scale application. While the High rate Shear Valve Pulser(HSVP), as a crucial component of the "Xuanji" system, can reach a maximum transmission rate of 20 bps under actual drilling conditions. The high-rate mud pulser utilizes mud pulses for signal transmission and can upload downhole logging data, wellbore trajectory, and engineering parameters to the surface system in real time. The surface data acquisition and demodulation system parses the received mud pulse signals to realize real-time communication between downhole instruments and the surface system. However, channel transmission characteristics such as acquisition noise and pump noise can interfere with the signal quality and affect the decoding success rate of surface signals. This paper analyzes the sources of noise, discusses the influences of channel characteristics, pump noise, acquisition noise, bottom hole assembly(BHA), drilling engineering parameters, mud parameters, and signal processing parameters on the decoding success rate, and adopts corresponding methods to handle the noise that affects the decoding success rate. This has greatly enhanced the decoding success rate of the signals and is of great significance for improving the real-time demodulation effect of high-speed mud pulse data transmission.

articleTitle: Laser Ranging-Based Detection Technology for Runway Contaminants at Cold Region Airports
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: During snowmelt, snow poses a significant safety hazard to aircraft takeoff and landing. When the airport runway surface is polluted by wet and dry snow, slush or frost, it will reduce the friction coefficient between the tire and the ground, resulting in reduced braking efficiency, and increase the taxi distance, interfering with the normal take-off and landing performance, thereby increasing the risk of flight operations. In this case, accurate and timely assessment of runway conditions becomes critical. However, due to the high moisture content and physical heterogeneity of slush, traditional manual measurement and snow thickness detection techniques are difficult to achieve accurate measurement. Therefore, this study proposes a rapid snow thickness detection method based on laser ranging technology. Considering the mixed composition characteristics of snow slush on airport surfaces, this study systematically explores the echo signal characteristics of wet snow and snow slush under different wavelengths. By analyzing the spectral reflectance curves, phase noise (PN), and signal amplitude of different snow samples, 650 nm and 850 nm wavelengths were identified as the most suitable for detection. A dual-wavelength laser snow thickness detection system was designed accordingly. This system utilizes frequency domain filtering, short-time Fourier transform (STFT), and Hilbert transform to process the non-stationary echo signals of snow slush and has been validated through field tests in various regions of northern China. Experimental results indicate that this system can attain high measurement accuracy across various meteorological conditions.

articleTitle: Automatic LPI Radar Waveform Recognition Method Based On Monobit Quantization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Intelligent Control, Measurement and Signal Processing (ICMSP)
abstract: Radar signal reconnaissance equipment requires real-time interception of enemy Low Probability of Intercept (LPI) radar signals for analysis and identification. Monobit receivers, leveraging their monobit ADC quantization width, enhance sampling rates, reduce data volume, and accelerate processing speeds, guiding the future development trend of radar reconnaissance equipment. This paper proposes, for the first time, an automatic recognition method for LPI radar waveforms based on monobit quantization. Firstly, we analyze the exceptional suitability of the Wigner-Ville Distribution (WVD) time-frequency analysis (TFA) method for monobit signals. Subsequently, we construct an Efficient Monobit LPI Radar Waveform Recognition Network based on Spatially Separable Convolutions (EMLN-SSC). This network effectively extracts and reduces the dimensionality of edge details in the time-frequency spectrum of monobit signals, achieving superior recognition rates compared to current State-of-The-Art (SOTA) models. Meanwhile, it reduces parameter quantity and computational complexity by over 48% and 28%, respectively. Despite a slight decrease of 1.62% in average recognition rate compared to traditional non-quantized signal recognition systems, the proposed method significantly reduces computational complexity, facilitating hardware deployment, and holding great potential in electronic reconnaissance.
